species.name: Dvati
traits: A Dvati character has two identical bodies sharing one soul. Each is a Medium Humanoid with 30-ft. land speed and darkvision 60 ft. The species has no racial ability adjustments or racial Hit Dice. LA +1 applies to the one character.

Both twins use the same level, classes, feats, skill ranks, and XP total. The pair counts as one PC for XP. The two bodies move and act separately, within the restrictions on their shared abilities and spellcasting.

Roll each Hit Die once. Each twin adds half the die result and the full Constitution modifier to their own hit points. Track damage and healing on each body. Both save and take damage separately when caught in an ordinary area effect.

Class uses and spell slots are one shared pool. Both twins normally take the casting actions together, with one providing materials. One twin can cast alone if the other takes no actions during the casting. Even a free action by the other twin ruins the attempt and loses the spell.

Personal spells affect both twins when they share a plane, or only the caster when on different planes. Ordinary touch spells affect the twin touched. Spell Conductor can shift an ongoing harmless touch spell to the other twin on the same plane as a move action. The pair can transfer a spell it casts as part of casting, and the text disallows transferring spells used by others.

Most effects stay with the body affected. A mind-affecting spell or ability affecting one twin affects both. If a single such effect targets both at once, use one save. Negative levels and levels lost through return to life apply to both. Use one save to remove a negative level.

Pair telepathy works across any distance and across planes. The twins do not share senses. A full-round action reveals the other twin’s current hit points and mental state, plus their direction and distance when on the same plane.

If a twin dies, each elapsed day deals 1d4 Constitution and Wisdom damage to the survivor and adds a cumulative −1 to attacks, skill checks, and saves. This damage and penalty cannot be removed while the survivor lives and their twin is dead. Both vanish immediately upon the missing twin’s return to life.
Pair Link gives both twins +3 to hit when they flank the same foe together. When one twin successfully aids the other’s attack or AC, the bonus is +4.

Echo Attack requires both twins to spend a move action speaking while flanking the same creature. Make one Perform (sing) check for the Will save DC. On a failed save choose +1 to both twins’ attacks against that creature or +1 to their AC against its attacks for one round. A creature must be able to hear and be flanked.
Common and Dvati are automatic. Any bonus language is eligible. Speaking Dvati takes two simultaneous speakers. Favored class Bard.

Four primary tentacle attacks deal 1d4 bludgeoning each before Strength.

Mind Blast (Sp) affects creatures in a 60-ft. cone. A failed Will save stuns for 3d4 rounds. The Charisma-based DC is 14 + Charisma modifier, reflecting a 4th-level equivalent. The entry gives no use limit.
Psionics (Sp), CL 8. At will, charm monster, detect thoughts, levitate, plane shift, and suggestion. Save DCs use Charisma.

Improved Grab (Ex). A tentacle hit on a Small, Medium, or Large creature allows a free grapple attempt without provoking. On success the tentacle attaches to the head. It can grab a Huge or larger creature if it can reach the head.

If one or more tentacles are attached at the start of the mind flayer’s turn, one grapple check can attach the rest. The target can escape all with one successful opposed grapple or Escape Artist check. The mind flayer gets a +2 circumstance bonus on the opposed check per tentacle attached at the start of the opponent’s turn.

Extract (Ex). Start the turn with all four tentacles attached and win a grapple check to extract the brain. This is normally fatal. The printed rule exempts constructs, elementals, oozes, plants, and undead, and extraction does not instantly kill a creature with multiple heads.
Telepathy (Su) communicates with a creature within 100 ft. that has a language. The two creatures can use different languages.
Spell resistance is 25 + class levels.

traits: Small Humanoid (Goblinoid). +2 Constitution, −2 Intelligence, −2 Charisma. Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Sonic resistance 5.

Light Blindness (Ex). Abrupt bright light, such as sunlight or daylight, blinds for 1 round. Take a −1 circumstance penalty on attacks, saves, and checks while in bright light.
Vulnerability to Poison (Ex). Take −4 on Fortitude saves against drow sleep poison and spiderkind venom.

Skinshift (Ex). As a move action, choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing and gain damage reduction 5 against that damage type for 3 + Constitution modifier rounds. One use per day, plus one more at 4th level and every four levels thereafter.

Shriek (Ex). Once per day as a standard action, emit a 15-ft.-radius burst centered on the vril or a 30-ft. cone. Creatures in the area take sonic damage. Reflex halves at DC 10 + half character level (round down) + Constitution modifier. Vril barbarians can use Shriek while raging.
Shriek deals 1d6 at levels 1–2, 2d6 at 3–5, 3d6 at 6–8, and 4d6 from level 9. This follows the errata’s written rule and its Warrior 3 stat block, which deals 2d6.
The errata also gives conflicting examples of 2d6 at level 6 and 3d6 at level 9, with a stated cap of 4d6 at level 12.

A character with Track can follow a scent trail using Survival. A fresh trail typically has DC 10, increasing by 2 per hour.

species.name: Fey’ri
traits: Medium Outsider (Native). +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, −2 Constitution. Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and low-light vision.
The natural winged form has a 40-ft. fly speed with poor maneuverability. Core flight requires a light load or less.
Immune to magic sleep. +2 racial bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects.
Elven Blood makes the fey’ri count as an elf for elf-specific effects and items.
+2 racial bonus on Bluff, Hide, Listen, Search, and Spot.

Change Shape (Su). At will as a standard action, assume a humanoid form. The form lasts until changed again or until death. Use the new form’s size and movement modes. Retain the original type, ability scores, Hit Dice, hit points, saves, and spellcasting. Gain +10 on Disguise when using the ability for a disguise.

The original 2003 player rules for D&D 3.0 use at-will alter self (Sp) for an indefinite humanoid form. This 3.5 adaptation uses Change Shape from the 2004 conversion of the earlier monster. True seeing reveals the natural form, and Change Shape cannot assume a templated form.

Choose four Demonic Abilities total. Options are charm person, clairaudience/clairvoyance, darkness, detect thoughts, dimension door, enervation, suggestion, DR 10/magic, fire resistance 10, +2 racial on saves against electricity, or +2 racial on saves against poison.
Each selected spell-like ability is usable once per day, with caster level equal to character level and Charisma-based save DCs.
Choose at most one of DR 10/magic, dimension door, and enervation. Taking one raises LA from +2 to +3. The original 2003 DR option was 10/+1. The player entry has no racial Hit Dice.
Common, Elven, and Abyssal are the languages named in the book. The language section also describes learning Gnoll, Goblin, Sylvan, and Draconic. Favored class Sorcerer.

+3 racial on saves against poison, +4 racial against disease, and +2 racial against spells and spell-like abilities.

Proficient with handaxe and blowgun in place of dwarven waraxe and urgrosh familiarity. +1 racial attack bonus against orcs and goblinoids and +4 dodge AC against giants.

Large size imposes −1 on attacks and AC, −4 to Hide, and grants +4 on grapple checks. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. The player entry specifies twice Medium lifting and carrying limits.
+8 racial bonus on Jump. A 40-ft. land speed adds another +4 under the core Jump rule. Jumping is part of movement. A running jump needs 20 ft. of run-up, or the DC doubles.

Two front claws are natural weapons that deal 1d6 piercing and slashing damage each before Strength. With a one-handed weapon, the player entry allows one secondary claw at −5 on the attack roll and half the Strength bonus to damage.

species.name: Avariel
traits: Winged elf. Medium Humanoid (Elf). +4 Dexterity, −2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom. Land speed 30 ft.

Immune to magical sleep. +2 racial bonus on saves against enchantment spells and effects. Low-light vision. +2 racial Listen and Search. Passing within 5 ft. of a secret or concealed door grants a Search check as if actively looking.
Keen Sight grants +4 racial Spot in place of the standard Elf +2. Avariels also get +4 racial Jump.
Choose proficiency with rapier or longsword. Also proficient with lasso and bolas. These replace standard Elf weapon proficiencies, including bows.

Fly 50 ft. (average) when carrying a Medium load or less, wearing no heavy armor, and neither fatigued nor exhausted. The wings must have room to extend fully. A Run in flight must follow a straight line.
An Avariel dive works as a charge. Descend at least 30 ft. and use a piercing weapon. A hit deals double damage.
Average maneuverability requires at least 25 ft. of forward movement each round to stay aloft and provides no hover. Upward flight is at half speed, with a maximum ascent angle of 60 degrees.
Common, Elven, and the home region language are automatic. The Avariel region grants Auran and offers Damaran, Draconic, Giant, Rashemi, Sylvan, and Tuigan as bonus languages.
Favored class Cleric. No racial Hit Dice. LA +3 gives ECL 4 at one class level.
This adaptation combines the 2003 D&D 3.0 Avariel traits with the 3.5 core Elf and aerial movement rules. It keeps the original dive’s 30-ft. descent and piercing weapon requirement.

species.name: Urdunnir
traits: Orecutter dwarf. Medium Humanoid (Dwarf). +2 Constitution, −2 Charisma. Darkvision 60 ft.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip when firmly grounded. Speed stays 20 ft. in medium or heavy armor or under a medium or heavy load.
Stonecunning grants +2 on Search for unusual stonework, including a reactive check within 10 ft. An Urdunnir can sense approximate depth and find stonework traps as a rogue can.
+4 racial bonus on saves against poison and +2 racial bonus on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.
Treat dwarven waraxes and urgroshes as martial weapons. +1 racial attack bonus against orcs and goblinoids, +4 dodge AC against giants, and +2 racial Appraise and Craft bonuses for stone or metal.

Stone Walk (Su) allows passage through stone and earth as though through air. The Urdunnir can bring up to twice their body weight. The Urdunnir and any passengers must hold their breath within the material.

Stone Shape (Sp), at will, caster level 8. Standard action, touch, up to 18 cu. ft. of stone, instantaneous, no save or spell resistance. Makes rough forms. A shape with moving parts has a 30% failure chance.
Shape Metal (Sp), at will once per round, caster level 8. Full-round action, touch, up to 5 cu. ft. of metal, instantaneous, Fortitude negates and spell resistance applies.

Shape Metal can reduce a touched armor’s protection by 1d6 (half for mostly nonmetal armor). Against a shield, weapon, or metallic creature it instead deals 4d6, bypassing hardness or damage reduction. Touching an unwilling creature or an item it holds requires a melee touch attack and normally provokes from that defender.
Automatic Dwarven and Undercommon. The Urdunnir region offers Alzhedo, Beholder, Common, Draconic, Elven, Giant, Gnome, or Terran as bonus languages.

In the 3.5 Realms, PCs also speak Common. Oldonnar lists Dwarven as its regional automatic language and Draconic, Giant, Terran, and Undercommon as regional bonus choices. This profile keeps the original racial Undercommon grant.
Favored class Expert. No racial Hit Dice. Level adjustment +4 gives ECL 5 at one class level.
This adaptation combines the 2003 D&D 3.0 player traits with the 3.5 core Dwarf and Stone Shape rules. Shape Metal keeps the player entry’s full-round activation and the appendix’s combat effects.

species.name: Kir-Lanan
traits: Medium Monstrous Humanoid. +4 Strength, +2 Dexterity, −2 Wisdom. Darkvision 60 ft., +3 natural armor, and +4 racial Hide. Space and reach 5 ft.
Land 30 ft. and fly 90 ft. with good maneuverability, which allows hovering under 3.5 aerial movement.
Two primary claws deal 1d4 piercing and slashing each before Strength. A full attack with a one-handed weapon can add one secondary claw at −5 and half the Strength bonus to damage.
Proficient with all simple weapons and light armor.

Four racial Hit Dice (4d8) give BAB +4, base Fortitude +1, Reflex +4, and Will +4, plus two chosen feats. Racial skill points are seven times (2 + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1). Racial class skills are Escape Artist, Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Spot, and Use Magic Device.

Negative Energy Touch (Su), 3/day. Make a melee touch attack or deliver it with a claw that hits normal AC. Deals 2d6 damage and 1 point of Strength damage. Fortitude DC 12 + Charisma modifier negates the Strength damage only. The Kir-Lanan regains HP equal to the hit point damage dealt by the negative energy, up to its maximum HP. Ignore claw damage and Strength damage when calculating healing.
Ray of Enfeeblement (Sp), 3/day at caster level 4. Ranged touch within 35 ft. The target takes a 1d6+2 Strength penalty for 4 minutes, to a minimum score of 1. No save. Spell resistance applies.
Rebuke or command undead 3/day as an evil Cleric of a level equal to the Kir-Lanan’s total Hit Dice.
Cure spells, holy water, and blessed weapons affect a Kir-Lanan as they would undead. Inflict spells and other negative energy heal it. A Kir-Lanan is a living creature and cannot be turned.

Soulless. Cannot use positive energy or divine magic or take levels in Cleric, Druid, or Paladin. Ranger levels grant no spellcasting. A Bard can learn inflict spells in place of cure spells. Return from death requires wish or miracle.
Common and Kir-Lanan are automatic. Bonus languages are by region. Favored class Fighter. Level adjustment +4 gives ECL 8 before class levels.
This 3.5 adaptation uses the original 2003 D&D 3.0 player traits. The 2004 monster conversion confirms the type, space, reach, and level adjustment.

species.name: Dekanter Goblin
traits: Medium Monstrous Humanoid. +6 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, −2 Charisma. Land speed 20 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and +4 natural armor.
Cold resistance 5 and fast healing 3. Recover 3 HP per round from damage the ability can heal.
Proficient with all simple weapons.
Two racial Hit Dice (2d8) grant BAB +2, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3, Will +3, and one feat. Maximize the first racial die and roll later dice, including the first class die.
Racial skill points are five times (2 + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1). Racial class skills are Climb, Intimidate, Jump, Listen, Sense Motive, and Spot.

Primary horn deals 1d6 plus Strength and has a ×3 critical. Two secondary claws deal 1d4 plus half the Strength bonus each and take −5 to hit. A weapon full attack can add one secondary horn or one secondary claw.
Goblin, Undercommon, and Common are automatic. Bonus languages are by region. Favored class Barbarian. Level adjustment +4 gives ECL 6 before class levels.
This is the March 2003 player profile. The later 3.5 conversion of the encounter monster lists Humanoid (Goblinoid), LA +3, and an alternate attack routine.

species.publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
species.name: Human
traits: Small or Medium, speed 30 feet. Choose one skill proficiency and one talent whose prerequisites you meet.

species.publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
species.name: Orc
traits: Medium, speed 30 feet. Heightened sight and hearing. Enter stasis instead of dying from suffocation or exhaustion; healing can restore you.
You can choose to make an effect’s end-of-turn save at the start of the turn instead.

species.name: Doppelganger
traits: Medium. +2 Intelligence and +2 Charisma. Speed 6 squares, normal vision, Common. Racial skill bonuses are +2 Bluff and +2 Insight.
Mental Defense gives +1 racial Will.

Change Shape is an at-will Polymorph minor action. Assume the appearance of a Medium humanoid, including an individual you have seen. Your statistics and equipment stay the same. The form lasts until you change it or die. Someone challenging your impersonation of an individual rolls Insight against your Bluff with a +20 bonus to your roll.
The Monster Manual presents these racial rules for NPCs and allows player characters to use them with the DM’s permission.

species.name: Githyanki
traits: Medium. +2 Constitution and +2 Intelligence. Speed 6 squares, normal vision, Common and Deep Speech. Racial skill bonus is +2 History.
Danger Sense gives +2 initiative. Githyanki Willpower gives +1 Will and +2 on saves against charm effects.
Telekinetic Leap is an encounter move action at range 10. You or one ally can fly up to 5 squares. If you choose an ally, they must stay in your line of sight throughout the flight.
The Monster Manual presents these racial rules for NPCs and allows player characters to use them with the DM’s permission.

species.name: Gnoll
traits: Medium. +2 Constitution and +2 Dexterity. Speed 7 squares, low-light vision, Abyssal and Common. Racial skill bonus is +2 Intimidate.
Blood Fury adds 2 to damage rolls while you are bloodied, or 4 at level 21.
Ferocious Charge is an encounter standard action. Charge and deal 2 extra damage on a hit. The extra damage rises to 4 at level 11 and 6 at level 21.
The Monster Manual presents these racial rules for NPCs and allows player characters to use them with the DM’s permission.

species.name: Kobold
traits: Small. +2 Constitution and +2 Dexterity. Speed 6 squares, normal vision, Common and Draconic. Racial skill bonuses are +2 Stealth and +2 Thievery.
Trap Sense grants +2 to defenses against traps.
Shifty is an at-will personal minor action that lets you shift 1 square.
The Monster Manual presents these racial rules for NPCs and allows player characters to use them with the DM’s permission.

species.name: Warforged
traits: Medium. +2 Strength and +2 Constitution. Speed 6 squares, normal vision, Common. Racial skill bonus is +2 Endurance.

Living Construct gives +2 on saves against ongoing damage. You can rest for 4 hours for an extended rest. You do not need to eat, drink, or breathe. On a death saving throw, you can take 10 if it is better than your roll.
Warforged Resolve is an encounter minor action you can use only while bloodied. Gain temporary HP equal to 3 + half your level.
The Monster Manual presents these racial rules for NPCs and allows player characters to use them with the DM’s permission.

species.name: Deva
traits: Medium, speed 6 squares, normal vision. Intelligence +2 and Wisdom +2. Speak Common and two other languages. History and Religion each gain a +2 racial bonus.
Immortal Origin counts as immortal for effects that check origin. Astral Majesty adds 1 to every defense when the attacker is bloodied.
Astral Resistance reduces necrotic and radiant damage by 5 plus half your level.
Memory of a Thousand Lifetimes is an encounter power that takes no action. After making an attack roll, saving throw, ability check, or skill check, add 1d6 to that roll if desired.

species.name: Githzerai
traits: Medium, speed 6 squares, normal vision. Wisdom +2 and choose Dexterity +2 or Intelligence +2. Speak Common and Deep Speech. Acrobatics and Athletics each gain a +2 racial bonus.
Danger Sense adds 2 to initiative. Defended Mind adds a +2 racial bonus to saving throws against daze, dominate, and stun effects.
Shifting Fortunes lets you shift 3 squares as a free action when you use second wind.
Iron Mind is a personal encounter interrupt when an attack hits you. Increase all your defenses by 2 until the end of your next turn, including against the triggering attack.

species.name: Minotaur
traits: Medium, speed 6 squares, normal vision. Strength +2 and choose Constitution +2 or Wisdom +2. Speak Common and one other language. Nature and Perception each gain a +2 racial bonus.

Vitality grants one extra healing surge. Ferocity gives a melee basic attack as an immediate interrupt when you drop to 0 HP or fewer. Heedless Charge grants +2 racial AC against opportunity attacks provoked while charging.

Goring Charge is an encounter standard action. Charge and use a horn strike in place of the usual basic attack. Pick Strength, Constitution, or Dexterity. Add 4 to that ability modifier to attack AC, rising to 6 at level 11 and 8 at level 21. On a hit, deal 1d6 plus the selected ability modifier and knock the target prone. The damage dice rise to 2d6 at level 11 and 3d6 at level 21.

species.name: Shardmind
traits: Medium, speed 6 squares, normal vision. Intelligence +2 and choose Wisdom +2 or Charisma +2. Speak Common, Deep Speech, and one other language. Gain +2 racial bonuses to Arcana, Endurance, and a third skill.
Telepathy works within 5 squares with creatures that have a language. Crystalline Mind gives resist 5 psychic, increasing to 10 at level 11 and 15 at level 21.

A living construct needs no food, drink, breath, or sleep and skips Endurance checks against starvation, thirst, and suffocation. An extended rest still takes six hours. Immortal Origin counts as immortal for origin effects.
Shard Swarm is an encounter move action. Each enemy in close burst 1 grants combat advantage to you through the end of your next turn. Then teleport half your speed.

species.name: Wilden
traits: Medium, speed 6 squares, low-light vision. Wisdom +2 and choose Constitution +2 or Dexterity +2. Speak Common and Elven. Nature and Stealth each gain a +2 racial bonus.
Fey Origin counts as fey for origin effects. For Hardy Form choose a +1 racial bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, or Will.
Nature’s Aspect chooses one aspect each time you finish an extended rest. Each aspect gives access to its own encounter power.

Voyage of the Ancients is a free action after you hit an enemy with an area or close attack. Teleport 3 squares. You and a visible ally gain combat advantage against one enemy hit until the end of your next turn.

Wrath of the Destroyer is an immediate reaction when a bloodied enemy attacks you or an adjacent ally. Make a melee basic attack against that enemy or charge it. A hit also dazes the enemy until the end of your next turn.

Pursuit of the Hunter is an immediate reaction when an enemy within 2 squares moves on its turn. Shift 3 squares. Through the end of your next turn, hits against that enemy deal 1d6 extra damage and you ignore its normal −2 cover or concealment penalty.

species.name: Genasi
traits: Medium elemental humanoid. +2 Strength and +2 Intelligence. Speed 6 squares, normal vision. Common and Primordial. +2 Endurance and Nature. Elemental Origin applies to effects keyed to creature origin.
Choose one active elemental manifestation. Extra Manifestation can add another option and lets you change your manifestation.

Earthsoul gives +1 Fortitude, +1 to saving throws, and Earthshock. Encounter minor, close burst 1 against grounded enemies. Chosen Strength, Constitution, or Dexterity +2 vs. Fortitude knocks a hit target prone. The racial attack bonus becomes +4 at level 11 and +6 at level 21.

Firesoul gives +1 Reflex, fire resistance 5, and Firepulse. Encounter immediate reaction after a melee hit from an enemy within 1 square. Chosen Strength, Constitution, or Dexterity +2 vs. Reflex deals 1d6 + the same modifier fire damage. At levels 11 and 21 the racial attack bonus increases to +4 and +6 and the dice to 2d6 and 3d6. Fire resistance rises to 10 and 15.

Stormsoul gives +1 Fortitude, lightning resistance 5, and Promise of Storm. Encounter minor, personal. Until the end of your next turn, a hit with a lightning or thunder attack deals an extra 1d8 damage under the August 2012 rules update. Resistance and damage dice rise to 10 and 2d8 at level 11, then 15 and 3d8 at level 21.

Watersoul breathes underwater and gains +2 to saving throws against ongoing damage. Swiftcurrent is an encounter move that shifts up to speed on land or liquid. You can cross enemy spaces and ignore squeezing, difficult terrain, and damage from the traversed surface.
Windsoul gives cold resistance 5 and Windwalker. Encounter move, fly 8 squares and drift safely down if you end above the ground. Cold resistance rises to 10 at level 11 and 15 at level 21.

species.name: Kalashtar
traits: Medium humanoid. +2 Wisdom and +2 Charisma. Speed 6 squares, normal vision. Common. +2 Insight and +2 to another chosen skill.
Telepathy 5 supports two-way communication with a creature that has a language, is within 5 squares, and is in line of sight.
Dual Soul lets you save at the start of your turn against each effect that dazes or dominates you. If a save fails, skip the end-of-turn save against that effect.

Bastion of Mental Clarity is an encounter immediate interrupt when an enemy hits or misses you against Will. You and allies in close burst 5 gain +4 power bonus to Will through the end of your next turn.

species.name: Mul
traits: Medium humanoid. +2 Constitution and +2 Strength or Wisdom. Speed 6 squares, normal vision. Common and Dwarven. +2 Endurance and Streetwise.
Born of Two Races. Choose human or dwarf feat prerequisites and meet all other requirements. Mul Vitality adds one healing surge.
Tireless needs only 6 hours of sleep per 72 hours to take an extended rest.
Incredible Toughness is an encounter power at the start of your turn and costs no action. End any ongoing damage or dazed, slowed, stunned, or weakened condition currently affecting you.

species.name: Thri-kreen
traits: Medium humanoid. +2 Dexterity and +2 Strength or Wisdom. Speed 7 squares, low-light vision. Common and Thri-Kreen. +2 Athletics and Nature.
Multiple Arms changes one weapon draw or sheathe, or item retrieval or storage, from a minor action to a free action each turn. Natural Jumper treats every jump as having a running start.
Torpor replaces sleep. Four hours of torpor count toward an extended rest, and you remain aware of your surroundings.

Thri-Kreen Claws is an encounter minor action, melee 1 against one to three enemies. Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom +3 vs. AC deals 1d8 + that modifier, with bonus damage equal to the number of targets. The racial attack bonus and dice rise to +6 and 2d8 at level 11 and +9 and 3d8 at level 21.

species.name: Bladeling
traits: Medium natural humanoid. +2 Dexterity and +2 Wisdom. Speed 6 squares, normal vision. Common. +2 Intimidate. Acid resistance is 5 + half your level.
At character creation choose Strength, Constitution, or Dexterity for Razor Storm attack rolls. Damage always uses Dexterity.

Razor Storm is an encounter minor action, close burst 1 against every creature in the burst, including allies. Chosen ability +2 vs. Reflex deals 1d6 + Dexterity modifier. At levels 11 and 21 the racial attack bonus increases to +4 and +6 and the dice to 2d6 and 3d6.
The Improved Razor Storm feat can substitute a close burst 2, with d8s instead of d6s plus ongoing 5 damage, save ends. Ongoing damage increases to 10 and 15 at levels 11 and 21.

species.name: Karsite
traits: Medium Humanoid (Human), 30-ft. land speed. +2 Constitution and +2 Charisma. Retains the human bonus feat, four extra skill points at 1st level and one per later level, and human languages.
Damage reduction 5/magic. Spell resistance equals 10 + class levels. When spell resistance blocks a spell, the Karsite heals twice the spell level in hit points.

A melee hit can suppress one magic weapon, suit of armor, or shield in the target’s possession for 1 round. The target negates this with Will DC 10 + the Karsite’s Charisma modifier. The Karsite may pick a visible item they know is magical. Otherwise, determine the item randomly.
Karsites cannot cast arcane or divine spells. Spell-like abilities, psionics, and magic item use still work. Proficient with martial weapons and light and medium armor.
Favored class Binder. No racial Hit Dice. Level adjustment +2. The book sets the CR to character level for NPC classes and character level +1 for PC classes.

species.name: Lumi
traits: Medium Outsider native to the Positive Energy Plane. Gains the Extraplanar subtype when away from its native plane. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft. +2 Strength, −2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, +4 Wisdom.

Two outsider Hit Dice provide 2d8, BAB +2, and base Fortitude, Reflex, and Will +3. Racial skill points equal five times (8 + Intelligence modifier). Racial class skills are Concentration, Diplomacy, Heal, Knowledge (the planes), Listen, Search, Sense Motive, and Spot. Gain +2 racial Search, Sense Motive, and Spot, plus Improved Initiative as a bonus feat.

Body of Light (Su) sheds white light to 5 ft. and grants immunity to death spells and magical death effects, energy drain, and negative energy. Positive-dominant planes still grant fast healing but give no temporary HP to a Lumi. Magical darkness can conceal its light.

Clear Vision (Ex) prevents blindness and dazzling, and grants immunity to direct light attacks such as searing light. Darkness and fog can still conceal opponents. A sun blade deals only nonlethal damage.
Floating Head (Ex) prevents strangulation, suffocation, and vorpal decapitation. Attackers receive no flanking bonus. The head stays a few inches above the shoulders and can rotate in place.
Spell-like abilities at caster level 3. At will, disrupt undead and light. Three times per day each, cure light wounds and glitterdust. Glitterdust save DC is 12 + Charisma modifier.

Common and Lumi are automatic. Bonus languages Abyssal, Celestial, Dwarven, and Infernal. Favored class Cleric. Lumi clerics channel positive energy regardless of alignment, worship Light, and may choose Law, Sun, or War domains. Level adjustment +2, ECL 4 before classes.

species.name: Maug
traits: Large Construct native to Acheron, 10-ft. space and reach. Speed 40 ft., cannot run. Darkvision 60 ft. and low-light vision under revised Construct traits. No Constitution score. Racial adjustments derived from the printed base scores are +10 Strength, +4 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and +2 Charisma.

Two racial construct Hit Dice, 2d10 plus 30 HP for Large size, BAB +1, and base Fortitude, Reflex, and Will +0. +7 natural armor and one slam for 1d8 before Strength. Applies standard Large attack, AC, Hide, and grapple modifiers.

Construct defenses include immunity to mind-affecting effects, poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, disease, magical death effects, necromancy, and Fortitude effects that cannot affect objects. Immune to critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, ability drain, and energy drain. Destroyed at 0 HP.

Pulverize (Su), 3/day as a standard action. Remove an object’s hardness for 1d4 rounds, Fortitude DC 18 negates. Affect up to a 10-ft. cube of its volume. Unattended nonmagical objects get no save. An object held, worn, or carried by a creature requires a melee touch attack that does not provoke.

Rapid Repair (Ex) restores 1 HP per full hour of rest while at 1 HP or more. An assistant with a DC 15 Craft (stonemasonry) check raises that rate to 2 HP an hour. Rapid Repair cannot regrow or reattach body parts.

Spell resistance 14 + class levels. Uses outsider skill points for its construct Hit Dice, for five times (8 + Intelligence modifier) racial skill points. +4 racial bonus to Craft (stonemasonry) and Knowledge (architecture and engineering), and Alertness as a bonus feat.
Common, Draconic, and Giant. Favored class Fighter. Level adjustment +3 and ECL 5 before class levels. Optional stone or metal grafts follow the separate rules in Appendix 2.

species.name: Nerra
traits: Varoot playable profile. Medium Outsider native to the Plane of Mirrors. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., +3 natural armor. Adjustments derived from the Varoot stat block are +4 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +4 Wisdom, and +6 Charisma.

Resistance 5 to cold, electricity, and fire. Takes 50% extra sonic damage. Reflective spell resistance equals 12 + class levels. Targeted spells stopped by this resistance reflect to their caster. Immune to gaze attacks, which likewise reflect to their source.

Mirror Jump (Su), at will. As a standard action, touch a mirror and exit through another mirror up to 1 mile away. A suitable highly reflective surface that is not a mirror has a 30% chance to work for entry only. If there is no mirror in range, travel on the Plane of Mirrors and emerge at a random mirror portal.
At caster level 12, disguise self 3/day (printed as change self), and mirror image 1/day. Gains bonus Exotic Weapon Proficiency with the shard dagger and shard longsword.

Speaks Common and its own language of mirror sounds. Favored class Rogue. Replace the Varoot’s single racial Hit Die with its first class level. Level adjustment +3, ECL 4 at first class level. Kalareem and Sillit have different player adjustments.

species.name: Centaur
traits: Large Monstrous Humanoid. Strength +8, Dexterity +4, Constitution +4, Intelligence −2, Wisdom +2. Walk 50 ft., darkvision 60 ft., +3 natural armor.
Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. Size modifiers are −1 AC and attacks, −4 Hide, +4 grapple. The character entry specifies twice Medium carrying limits.

Four racial d8 Hit Dice grant BAB +4, base saves Fort +1, Ref +4, Will +4, and two feats. Skill points are 7 × (2 + Intelligence modifier), with the normal minimum. Racial class skills are Listen, Move Silently, Spot, and Survival.
Two secondary hooves deal 1d6 base damage each. Under the printed combat rule, a lance charge deals double damage.
Sylvan and Elven are automatic. Common, Gnome, and Halfling are bonus choices. Favored class Ranger. LA +2, ECL 6 before class levels.

species.name: Hound Archon
traits: Medium Outsider with the Archon, Good, and Lawful subtypes. On the Material Plane it also has the Extraplanar subtype. Strength +4, Constitution +2, Wisdom +2, Charisma +2. Walk 40 ft., +9 natural armor, darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, and scent.

Six racial d8 Hit Dice grant BAB +6, base Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +5, and three feats. Skill points are 9 × (8 + Intelligence modifier). Racial class skills are Concentration, Hide, Jump, Listen, Move Silently, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival.

Bite 1d8 and slam 1d4. Treat natural and wielded weapons as good and lawful for overcoming damage reduction. DR 10/evil, immunity to electricity and petrification, +4 racial bonus against poison, and SR 16 + class levels.

Aura of menace within 20 ft. of a hostile archon, Will DC 15 + Charisma modifier. Failure imposes −2 on attacks, AC, and saves for 24 hours or until the victim hits the archon. A creature that resists or breaks the effect avoids that archon's aura for 24 hours.

Constant magic circle against evil at caster level equal to Hit Dice. Constant tongues and at-will greater teleport at CL 14, with teleport restricted to self and up to 50 lb. of objects. At will aid, continual flame, detect evil, and message at CL 6.

Change shape to a Small through Large canine. Its normal attacks give way to that form's bite. Canine shape gives a +4 circumstance bonus to Hide and Survival. Celestial is automatic. Common, Draconic, and Infernal are bonus choices. Favored class Ranger. LA +5, ECL 11 before classes.

species.name: Janni
traits: Medium Native Outsider. Strength +6, Dexterity +4, Constitution +2, Intelligence +4, Wisdom +4, Charisma +2. Walk 30 ft., fly 20 ft. with perfect maneuverability. Darkvision 60 ft. and +1 natural armor.

Six racial d8 Hit Dice grant BAB +6, base Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +5, three feats, and bonus Improved Initiative. Racial skill points are 9 × (8 + Intelligence modifier). Racial class skills are Appraise, Concentration, Craft, Escape Artist, Listen, Move Silently, Ride, Sense Motive, and Spot.
Fire resistance 10, telepathy 100 ft. Elemental endurance allows 48 hours on an Elemental Plane. After that, take 1 damage each additional hour until death or return to the Material Plane.

Change size twice daily as enlarge person or reduce person, with self as an additional valid target. Fort DC 12 + Charisma modifier. At CL 12 use self-only invisibility and speak with animals three times daily, and ethereal jaunt for 1 hour once daily. Create food and water once daily at CL 7.
Plane shift at CL 13 to the Material Plane, Astral Plane, or any of the four Elemental Planes. May take up to eight other creatures who link hands with the janni.
Common is automatic. Abyssal, Aquan, Auran, Celestial, Ignan, Infernal, and Terran are bonus choices. Favored class Rogue. LA +5, ECL 11 before classes.

species.name: Lizardfolk
traits: Medium Humanoid (Reptilian). Strength +2, Constitution +2, Intelligence −2. Walk 30 ft., +5 natural armor, proficiency with simple weapons and shields.

Two racial d8 Hit Dice grant BAB +1, base saves Fort +0, Ref +3, Will +0, and one feat. Racial skill points are 5 × (2 + Intelligence modifier), minimum 1 point per equivalent HD. Balance, Jump, and Swim are racial class skills and each has a +4 racial bonus.
Two claws and a bite, each with 1d4 base damage. The claws are primary and the bite is secondary in the standard full-attack routine.
Hold breath for four times the Constitution score in rounds before risking drowning. Swim checks use the listed racial bonus. The entry supplies a land speed.
Common and Draconic are automatic for characters. Aquan, Goblin, Gnoll, and Orc are bonus languages. Favored class Druid. LA +1, ECL 3 before classes.

species.name: Pixie
traits: Small Fey. Strength −4, Dexterity +8, Intelligence +6, Wisdom +4, Charisma +6. Walk 20 ft., fly 60 ft. with good maneuverability. Low-light vision. +1 natural armor and +2 racial bonus to Listen, Search, and Spot.
Size grants +1 AC and attacks, +4 Hide, −4 grapple, and three-quarters Medium carrying limits. First class level replaces the single fey Hit Die. Dodge and Weapon Finesse are bonus feats.
DR 10/cold iron. SR 15 + class levels. Constant greater invisibility continues through attacks and can be suppressed or resumed as a free action.

At CL 8, each 1/day. Lesser confusion, dancing lights, detect chaos, detect good, detect evil, detect law, detect thoughts, dispel magic, entangle, and permanent image limited to sight and sound. Save DCs use Charisma. Some pixies also have irresistible dance 1/day at CL 8.
Common and Sylvan are automatic. Elven, Gnome, and Halfling are bonus choices. Favored class Sorcerer. LA +4, or +6 with irresistible dance.

species.name: Bearfolk
traits: Medium. Walk 30 ft. Strength +2. Shadowborn add Dexterity +1.
Bite. Make an unarmed strike for 1d6 + Strength modifier piercing damage.
Natural Armor starts at AC 13 + Dexterity modifier. A shield can add to that AC.
Powerful Build counts as one size larger for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Ursine Talent grants Athletics and Perception proficiency.
Shadowborn have darkvision 60 ft. With Cloak of Night, dim light or darkness grants advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and permits Hide as a bonus action.
Speak, read, and write Common for a mortal-land origin or Umbral for a Shadow Realm origin.

species.name: Darakhul
traits: Constitution +1 and darkvision 60 ft. Choose a heritage for size, speed and added traits.

Imperfect Undeath. Humanoid affected by effects that specifically target undead. Normal healing works. Ordinary resurrection returns a Darakhul. True Resurrection or Wish can return the original living form.

Hunger for Flesh. Eat 1 lb. of raw meat every 24 hours or gain one exhaustion level. While hunger exhaustion remains, healing and recovery from exhaustion are blocked until spending at least an hour eating 10 lb. of raw meat.

Powerful Jaw. Bite unarmed strike for 1d4 + Strength modifier piercing. Sunlight Sensitivity gives disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception if the character, target or subject is in direct sunlight.

Undead Resilience gives necrotic and poison resistance, disease immunity and advantage on saves against charm or poison. A short rest removes one exhaustion level if at least 1 lb. of raw meat was eaten within 24 hours, subject to Hunger for Flesh.
Undead Vitality. No breathing. Six hours of semiconscious dormancy give the sleep benefit of eight human hours. Perception checks during dormancy have disadvantage.

Common heritage rules grant Darakhul, Umbral and the heritage language. Bearfolk Heritage adds Strength +2 and Common for a mortal-land origin or Umbral for a Shadow Realm origin. Medium, speed 30 ft. Jaws of Death raises bite damage to 1d6 + Strength. Undead Fortitude lets a survivor of a drop to 0 HP drop to 1 instead once per long rest.

Shadow Goblin Heritage adds Dexterity +2 and Goblin and Umbral. Small, speed 30 ft. Dark Deed is an action against a visible target within 30 ft. that can see and hear the Darakhul. On a failed Wisdom save against DC 10 + Charisma modifier, it is frightened of the Darakhul through the end of its turn.

species.name: Quickstep
traits: Small. Walk 50 ft. Dexterity +2 and Charisma +1. Darkvision 60 ft.
Fey Ancestry grants advantage on saves against charm and prevents magical sleep.
Nimble grants Acrobatics and Sleight of Hand proficiency.

Startling Speed can be used for a number of rounds each day equal to character level. Move at least 10 ft. on your turn to impose disadvantage on attacks against you through the start of your next turn. Incapacitated or restrained Quicksteps cannot use it.
Speak, read, and write Elvish and Umbral.

species.name: Ratatosk
traits: Dexterity +2 and Strength −2. Walk 25 ft., climb 10 ft., and darkvision 60 ft. Humanoid that can be targeted by effects specifically aimed at celestials.
Sharp Tusks. Unarmed strike for 1 piercing plus 1d4 psychic damage.
Speak telepathically to a visible creature within 10 ft. per character level if it understands at least one language. Read, write and understand Celestial and Common.

Ekorre are Tiny and gain Intelligence +1 or Charisma +1. They know Message and Vicious Mockery, and can cast Mirror Image once per long rest from 5th level. Use Charisma. Ekorre use light or finesse weapons normally. Other weapons take two hands and impose disadvantage. They cannot use heavy weapons. Weapons made for Tiny users can bypass the size restrictions.

Tradvakt are Small and add Constitution +1. War Chatter targets one non-Ratatosk within 30 ft. that can hear the speaker. As a bonus action, demand a Charisma save against DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier. Failure imposes disadvantage on attacks through the start of your next turn. Recharge on a short or long rest.

species.name: Shadow Goblin
traits: Small. Walk 30 ft. Dexterity +2 and Charisma +1. Darkvision 60 ft.
Quick Wit grants Deception and Insight proficiency. Shadow Camouflage gives advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) to hide in dim light or darkness.

Stink Eye. As an action, target a creature you can see within 30 ft. that can see and hear you. It makes a Charisma save against DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier. On a failure its next ability check, attack roll or saving throw before your next turn starts has disadvantage.

Sunlight Sensitivity gives disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception if you, the target or what you seek to see is in direct sunlight. Unseelie Blessing grants advantage on saves against charm and prevents magical sleep.
Speak, read and write Goblin and Umbral.

species.name: Disembodied
traits: +2 Intelligence and +1 Dexterity. Choose the appearance and size of the humanoid you were before the accident. You weigh one-quarter of your former weight and have a 30-ft. walking speed. The origin grants no other traits.

Fade Away. As an action, enter the Ethereal Plane for up to 1 minute. You can move, hear, and see in grayscale. The Material Plane and anything on it cannot affect you and you cannot affect them. End the effect early as a bonus action. On return, use the nearest unoccupied space to the point where you disappeared. Recharges on a long rest.
Planar Outcast. Cast feather fall on yourself once per day. At level 3, cast blur once per day. At level 5, cast blink once per day. Intelligence governs these spells.
Arcane Origins grants Arcana proficiency. Speak, read, and write two languages of your choice.

species.name: Dreamer
traits: +2 Intelligence and +1 Constitution. Medium. Walking speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft.

Dreamwalking. While asleep you can touch the dreams of others within 1 mile. After a long rest that included sleep, choose one skill or tool. Add your proficiency bonus to rolls using that choice until your next long rest.
Even in Sleep. Sleep imposes no penalty on Perception checks that rely on senses other than sight.
Power Nap. Sleep for 1 hour during a short rest to reduce exhaustion by one level and regain one Hit Die in addition to the usual rest benefits.
Speak, read, and write Dreamspeak, Dwarvish, and one other language.

species.name: Laneshi
traits: +1 Strength and +1 Wisdom. Medium. Walking and swimming speeds 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and can breathe air and water.
Beast Whisperers. Know speak with animals. Cast it once per day through this trait and regain that use after a long rest. Speak, read, and write Laneshi and one other language.

Warrior caste. Another +1 Strength, for +2 total. Gain proficiency with spears, tridents, javelins, light armor, and Animal Handling. After you hit a hostile creature with a weapon attack, you can Disengage as a bonus action before the end of that turn.

Mystic caste. Another +1 Wisdom, for +2 total. Resist psychic damage and roll Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves against magic with advantage. The first time Duality of Spirit activates after a long rest, also make a DC 12 Wisdom save or become stunned through the end of your next turn.
Laneshi Magic, available to the Mystic caste. Learn a necromancy cantrip and another necromancy cantrip at level 5. Wisdom governs both.

species.name: Ogresh
traits: +2 Charisma, +1 Constitution, and +1 Wisdom. Medium. Walking speed 30 ft.
Takes One to Know One. Advantage on saves against being charmed.
Powerful Build. Count as one size larger for carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.
Gift of Gab. Choose proficiency in two of Persuasion, Insight, Deception, or Performance.

A Friendly Ear. After speaking with a nonhostile creature for at least 1 minute, you can ask for a Wisdom save at DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier. On failure the creature is charmed by you for 1 hour and you learn one fact it knows about the topic, chosen by the DM. The creature remains unaware of the attempt either way. Recharges on a short rest.
Speak, read, and write three languages of your choice.

species.name: Wechselkind
traits: +2 Constitution and +1 Charisma. Small Humanoid, despite its artificial construction. Walking speed 25 ft. Immune to magical aging.
Artificial Form. Advantage on saves against being poisoned, resistance to poison damage, and immunity to disease. You have no need to eat, drink, sleep, or breathe.
Faerie Glamour. Once per long rest, cast disguise self using Charisma. Your only available guise is the specific child you were made to replace.
Childish Agility. Proficiency in Acrobatics. You can move through the space of any creature larger than you.
Speak, read, and write Sylvan and one other language.

species.name: Corvum
traits: Crowlike birdfolk with dark, often iridescent feathers.
Medium humanoid, speed 30 ft., Intelligence +2.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Talons. Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 piercing. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.
Learned. Gain proficiency in Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion.
Appraising Eye. Spend an action examining an object to learn its magical properties, how to activate it, and an estimated market price. Regain the use after a short or long rest.
Speak, read, and write Birdfolk. Understand spoken Auran.
Dusk Corvum. Dexterity +1, Insight proficiency, and advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.

Kindled Corvum. Charisma +1 and proficiency in Deception or Persuasion. Gain advantage on Charisma checks to convince someone of your expertise in your Learned subject. Learn one language and one tool proficiency, and recall sights and sounds from the last month exactly.

species.name: Gallus
traits: Landfowl birdfolk with many distinct plumages, including hen, pheasant, and grouse forms.
Medium humanoid, speed 30 ft., Wisdom +2.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Wing Flap. As a bonus action, rise up to half your movement speed. You can combine this with a jump, and use it only outside a glide.

Communal. Add twice your proficiency bonus to History checks about your people, culture, or community. Gain simple weapon proficiency and proficiency in brewer’s supplies, carpenter’s tools, or smith’s tools.
Speak, read, and write Birdfolk. Understand spoken Auran.
Bright Gallus. Charisma +1 and Insight proficiency. Spend an action encouraging an ally who can see and hear you. That ally adds 1d4 to their next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.
Huden Gallus. Dexterity +1 and Nature proficiency. Use speech and touch to exchange simple ideas with living plants. Plants report sensations such as touch, temperature, or vibrations.

species.name: Luma
traits: Small pigeon- or dove-like birdfolk, often with an iridescent ruff.
Small humanoid, speed 25 ft., Charisma +2.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Wing Flap. As a bonus action, rise up to half your movement speed. You can combine this with a jump, and use it only outside a glide.
Touched. Learn one sorcerer cantrip and cast it using Charisma.
Fated. Once per long rest, reroll an attack, check, or save after rolling and before learning the outcome.
Speak, read, and write Birdfolk. Understand spoken Auran.

Sable Luma. Constitution +1. Creatures have disadvantage on Insight checks against you. You have advantage on Deception against non-Lumas. Gain advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage.
Sera Luma. Wisdom +1 and Performance proficiency. While performing, cast charm person once per long rest using Charisma and without somatic components.

species.name: Raptor
traits: Small hawk- and eagle-like birdfolk with keen eyes and long talons.
Small humanoid, speed 25 ft., Dexterity +2.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Talons. Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 piercing. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.
Keen Senses grants Perception proficiency. Woodland Hunter reduces the target’s three-quarters cover to half cover and half cover to no cover.
Hunter’s Training grants proficiency with longbows, shortbows, and spears. Longbows lack the heavy property for you.
Speak, read, and write Birdfolk. Understand spoken Auran.
Maran Raptor. Intelligence +1 and swim speed 25 ft. When you take a readied action, gain advantage on the first attack, skill check, or ability check made as part of it.
Mistral Raptor. Wisdom +1 and Acrobatics proficiency. Attacks against you have disadvantage while you are falling, gliding, or jumping.

species.name: Strig
traits: Stocky owl-like birdfolk with thick mottled feathers and broad feathered arms.
Medium humanoid, speed 30 ft., Strength +2. Darkvision 60 ft.

Glide. React while falling to descend at 60 ft. per round and land without fall damage. If the fall is at least 10 ft., glide in one direction up to movement speed, without gaining height, and land at the end. Heavy weapons, shields, heavy armor, and encumbrance prevent gliding. You can drop held gear as part of the reaction.
Talons. Unarmed strikes deal 1d4 piercing. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces your talons can grip.
Patterned Feathers grants advantage on Stealth checks made to hide in a forest.
Speak, read, and write Birdfolk. Understand spoken Auran.
Stout Strig. Constitution +1 and Intimidation proficiency. After hitting with your talons, you may try to grapple that target as a bonus action.
Swift Strig. Dexterity +1, walking speed 35 ft., and Survival proficiency.

species.name: Cervan
traits: Medium deerlike humanoid. Walking speed 30 ft. Constitution +2. Proficiency in one of Athletics, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

Surge of Vigor. When an attack inflicts more than half your current HP in damage, immediately regain 1d12 + your Constitution modifier HP. This can trigger when the hit takes you to 0 HP. Once per long rest.
Grove cervan. Dexterity +1 and walking speed 35 ft. Long jump 30 ft. and high jump 15 ft. with or without a running start. Opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

Pronghorn cervan. Strength +1. Double carrying capacity and push, drag, and lift limits. Antler unarmed strike deals 1d6 + Strength modifier piercing. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward an opponent, the charge costs a bonus action and adds 1d6 piercing. A Large or smaller target makes a Strength save at DC 8 + proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier. On failure, push it 10 ft. away into a space you choose.
Speak, read, and write Birdfolk. Cervan is spoken only.

species.name: Hedge
traits: Small hedgehoglike humanoid. Walking speed 25 ft., burrowing speed 15 ft. through soil. Charisma +2, Wisdom +1.
Spiny Quills. Armor cannot be worn. Base AC is 14 + Dexterity modifier. A shield still grants its bonus if proficient.

Curl Up. As an action, curl into a ball. Base AC becomes 19 without a Dexterity bonus, and a usable shield still applies. While curled, you cannot move, attack, or cast spells that have a somatic component. A creature that misses you with a melee attack takes 2d4 piercing. If a creature hits you, you fall prone at the end of the turn. You may uncurl during your turn.
Forest Magic. Know druidcraft and cast animal messenger at 2nd level once per short or long rest. Both use Charisma.
Speak With Bugs. Convey simple ideas to Beast insects, spiders, worms, and similar creatures using sounds and gestures. Speak, read, and write Birdfolk and Hedge.

species.name: Jerbeen
traits: Small mouse- or jerboa-like humanoid. Walking speed 30 ft. Dexterity +2, Charisma +1. Standing long jump 30 ft. and high jump 15 ft., with or without a running start.
Nimbleness. Move through a larger creature’s space. Team Tactics allows the Help action as a bonus action.

Take Heart. Gain advantage on Strength saves and on saves against being frightened when you are within 5 ft. of an ally you can see and hear, provided that ally is neither frightened nor incapacitated.
Speak, read, and write Birdfolk and Jerbeen.

species.name: Mapach
traits: Medium raccoonlike humanoid. Walking speed 30 ft., climb speed 20 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Wisdom +2, Constitution +1.
Resilience. Advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage. Skulker grants advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.

Scroungecraft. Gain tinker’s tools proficiency. With suitable material, spend 10 minutes to improvise a tool or piece of adventuring gear worth up to 30 gp. Tools and expendable items are useful for one use. Other items generally last 1 hour.

With proper materials, start before the temporary item fails and spend 8 hours to make it permanent. Scroungecraft can also repair equipment, with available materials and repair durability at the GM’s discretion.
Speak, read, and write Birdfolk and Mapach.

species.name: Vulpin
traits: Medium foxlike humanoid. Walking speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Intelligence +2, Charisma +1.
Bite. Use Strength or Dexterity for both attack and damage rolls for this unarmed strike. Damage is 1d6 piercing plus the chosen modifier.
Evasive. Add your Intelligence modifier to Dexterity saving throws.

Bewitching Guile. Cast charm person at first level, ambush prey at third level as a 2nd-level spell, and fear at fifth level. Each racial spell has its own use per long rest. These spells use Intelligence.

Ambush prey. Become invisible for up to 1 hour. Moving at least 5 ft. from the casting point ends it. The first attack against an unaware target deals an extra 1d6 damage and ends the effect. Full spell rules are on p. 49.
Speak, read, and write Birdfolk and Vulpin.

species.name: Dragonborn
traits: Medium Humanoid. Walking speed 30 ft. Mature by 15 and typically live about 80 years.
Dragon Sight grants 60-ft. darkvision and 10-ft. keensense, which precisely senses nearby surroundings without sight.

Draconic Ancestry determines breath damage and Dragon Hide resistance. Black or copper gives acid, blue or bronze lightning, brass, gold or red fire, silver or white cold, green poison, void necrotic, and yellow radiant.

Breath Weapon uses a bonus action. Choose a 30-by-5-ft. line or a 15-ft. cone each time. Creatures in the area make a DEX save against 8 + CON modifier + PB. Failed saves take 1d10 ancestry damage, with half on success.
Breath damage becomes 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at 11, and 4d10 at 17. Uses equal PB per long rest.
The ancestry introduction refers to Natural Adaptation. The playable trait block supplies no additional adaptation effect.

species.name: Gearforged
traits: Humanoid in a constructed body. Choose a chassis modeled on another lineage at character creation and use its size and height. Base walking speed 30 ft. A maintained chassis has no known lifespan limit.
Hybrid Humanoid grants disease immunity, poison damage resistance, and advantage on saves against the paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.

Constructed Vitality removes the need to eat, drink, or breathe. Spend six hours semiconscious and dormant in place of sleep, with disadvantage on Perception checks during dormancy. That rest gives the benefit of eight hours of sleep.
Speak and understand Machine Speech, the mechanical language of gearforged and mechadrons.

Choose one Upgrade. Always Armed integrates a suitable melee weapon in each arm, up to two total. Two-Handed weapons are excluded. Weapons using ammunition still require ammunition. Integrating or replacing a weapon takes ten minutes.

With Always Armed, drawing or sheathing the weapon folds it out of or back into the arm. A drawn weapon occupies the hand. A sheathed weapon passes concealment checks automatically. You cannot willingly let it be disarmed. Deliberate removal takes an action.
Bulk Up uses a bonus action to become Large for PB rounds if you have space. Weapon attacks deal another 1d4, and STR checks and saves have advantage. Once per long rest.
Quick Fix uses a bonus action while below half your maximum HP to gain temporary HP equal to twice PB. Once per short or long rest.

species.name: Satyr
traits: Medium Fey. Walking speed 30 ft. Reach adulthood at about 20 and can live 300 years or more.
Natural Attack grants a horn strike using your choice of STR or DEX, chosen at creation. A hit deals 1d8 + the chosen modifier in bludgeoning damage.
Bounding Leap lets you use your reaction after a hit with a melee weapon or unarmed strike to move half speed without drawing opportunity attacks. Uses equal PB per long rest.

Fey Resilience grants advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects. Resistance to the charmed and unconscious conditions grants advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end those conditions.

species.name: Syderean
traits: Spellborn is a Natural Adaptation choice for the Syderean lineage from the Player’s Guide. Medium Humanoid, 30-ft. walking speed, adulthood around 20 and average lifespan about 150 years.

Far Sight grants darkvision 60 ft. and vision in magical darkness for 30 ft. Otherworldly Form grants necrotic resistance and doubles the time the character can survive without air, food, water, or sleep.
Energy Form is a bonus action once per long rest, lasting one minute. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder when you take the form.

In Energy Form you resist bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks and cannot become restrained. Once on each of your turns, you may change the damage type or types dealt by one of your attacks or spells to the chosen damage type.

species.name: Sapopova
species.publication: Tales of the Valiant Player's Guide 2 Preview
traits: Small Humanoid. Walking and swimming speeds 30 ft. Amphibian allows breathing in air and water. Mature around eight years old and rarely live past 50.
Superior Vision gives 60-ft. darkvision in full color and advantage on WIS (Perception) checks to visually find creatures and moving targets.
Choose one Natural Adaptation. Frogkin are proficient in Athletics and can make long jumps without a 10-ft. running start.

Toadfolk can hold up to three Tiny objects in their cheeks while speaking normally. They are proficient at launching Tiny objects as ranged weapon attacks. Treat the object as a weapon with Thrown and a 20/60-ft. range. A hit deals 1d6 + DEX modifier in bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage appropriate to the object.
This profile follows the publisher’s Player’s Guide 2 preview, which presents both adaptations under one lineage.

species.name: Daelkyr Half-Blood
traits: Medium Aberration. Land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Proficient with all simple weapons and any weaponlike symbiont used. Armor proficiencies come from class.

Personal Symbiont (Ex). At first level choose a breed leech, crawling gauntlet, or throwing scarab. At 5th level stormstalk and winter cyst become options, at 10th spellwurm and tentacle whip, and at 15th tongue worm. Earlier choices remain available.
Growing a new personal symbiont replaces the old one. A lost personal symbiont takes 2d4 days to regrow once the original has died. This ability applies only to the personal symbiont.
Symbiont Mastery is a racial bonus feat. Gain +4 on Will saves in symbiont personality conflicts and +2 HP per attached symbiont. The extra HP vanish immediately when it detaches.
Symbiont Dependence (Ex). Take 1 Constitution damage after each 24 hours without contact with any symbiont. That damage cannot be restored until contact resumes.
Unbalanced Mind (Ex). A creature trying to read or study the half-blood’s mind must make a Will save at DC 10 + half the half-blood’s level + their Charisma modifier or be dazed for 1 round.
Common is automatic. Daelkyr is the bonus language. Favored class Rogue. No racial Hit Dice, ability score adjustments, or level adjustment.

species.name: Drow
traits: Medium, speed 6 squares, darkvision. Dexterity +2 and Charisma +2. Speak Common and Elven. Gain +2 to Intimidate and Stealth.
Trance takes four hours and gives the benefits of a six-hour extended rest. The drow stays aware of nearby activity.

Lolthtouched allows either Cloud of Darkness or Darkfire once per encounter. Cloud of Darkness is a minor close burst 1 that stays in place through the end of your next turn. It blocks line of sight for everyone except you and blinds other creatures entirely inside it.

Darkfire is a minor ranged 10 attack against one creature’s Reflex. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma permanently at creation. Add a +2 bonus to the ability-based attack at heroic tier, +4 at paragon tier, and +6 at epic tier. A hit grants combat advantage to attackers and suppresses the target’s invisibility and concealment through the end of your next turn.

species.name: Bugbear
traits: Medium, speed 6 squares, low-light vision. Strength +2 and Dexterity +2. Speak Common and Goblin. Gain +2 to Intimidate and Stealth.
Oversized lets a bugbear wield a weapon one size larger as though it were a weapon of the bugbear’s own size.

Predatory Eye is a once-per-encounter minor action. When you have combat advantage against a target, use it to add 1d6 damage on your next attack against that target by the end of your next turn. The extra damage is 2d6 at level 11 and 3d6 at level 21.

species.name: Hobgoblin
traits: Medium, speed 6 squares, low-light vision. Constitution +2 and Charisma +2. Speak Common and Goblin. Gain +2 to Athletics and History.
Battle Ready adds +2 to initiative.
Hobgoblin Resilience allows a saving throw as an immediate reaction once per encounter when you suffer an effect that a save can end.

species.name: Gnome
traits: Small, speed 5 squares, low-light vision. Intelligence +2 and Charisma +2. Speak Common and Elven. Gain +2 to Arcana and Stealth.
Fey Origin makes you fey for rules that check origin. Trickster’s Cunning grants a +5 racial bonus to saving throws against illusions.
Master Trickster lets you use Ghost Sound as a minor action once per encounter. Reactive Stealth lets you check Stealth when you roll initiative if you have cover or concealment.
Fade Away is an immediate reaction once per encounter when you take damage. Become invisible until you attack or your next turn ends, whichever comes first.

species.name: Shade
traits: Medium. +2 Charisma and either +2 Dexterity or +2 Intelligence. Speed 6 squares, darkvision, Common and one other language. +2 Arcana and +2 Stealth.
Fragile Mortality removes one healing surge from your normal total. Practiced Sneak grants Stealth training. Shadow Origin applies to effects keyed to creature origin.
Master of Shadows lets you replace a class utility choice above 1st level with a Shade utility of the same or a lower level.
One with Shadow is an at-will standard action. Through the end of your next turn, ordinary cover or concealment is enough to attempt to hide, and cover from allies can help you become or stay hidden.

species.name: Vryloka
traits: Medium. +2 Charisma and either +2 Strength or +2 Dexterity. Speed 7 squares, low-light vision, Common and one other language. +2 Perception and +2 Stealth.
Blood Dependency reduces your healing surge value by 2 while bloodied. Human Heritage adds +5 to Bluff checks to pass as human.
You count as living and undead. If an effect has a different result for each, you choose which to use. Resist necrotic damage equal to 5 plus half your level.
Vampiric Heritage lets you take a Vryloka utility power in place of a class utility choice above 1st level, at the same level or lower.

Lifeblood is a free action once per encounter when you bloody or kill an enemy. Choose a shift up to your speed, temporary HP equal to 5 plus half your level, or a +2 power bonus on attack rolls through the end of your next turn.

species.name: Revenant
traits: Medium. +2 Dexterity and either +2 Charisma or +2 Constitution. Speed 6 squares, low-light vision, Common and one other language. +2 Endurance and +2 Intimidate.
You count as living and undead. Choose a prior race for prerequisites such as feats and paragon paths.
Unnatural Vitality lets you take the dazed condition in place of unconsciousness when dying at 0 HP or below. Make the usual death saves. A failed save leaves you unconscious.

Dark Reaping is a free action once per encounter when a creature drops to 0 HP within 5 squares. Add 1d8 plus Constitution modifier necrotic damage to one creature you hit before the end of your next turn.

species.name: Hamadryad
traits: Medium. +2 Wisdom and either +2 Intelligence or +2 Charisma. Speed 6 squares, low-light vision, Common and Elven. +2 Diplomacy and +2 Nature. The book presents Hamadryads as female fey.
Forest Walk lets you ignore difficult terrain from forest growth. Oaken Vitality doubles the time before checks against starvation, thirst, or suffocation, and adds +5 to those Endurance checks.
You replace sleep with four hours of meditation with light, water, or contact with earth to gain an extended rest. You remain aware while meditating.
Tree Mind adds +2 to saves against effects that daze, dominate, or stun.

Hamadryad Aspects is a minor action once per encounter. Through the end of your next turn, either enemies that see you grant you combat advantage, or you resist all damage by 5, rising to 10 at level 11 and 15 at level 21.

species.name: Shadar-kai
traits: Medium. +2 Dexterity and +2 Intelligence. Speed 6 squares, low-light vision, Common and one other language. +2 Acrobatics and +2 Stealth.
Shadow Origin applies to effects keyed to creature origin. Winterkin adds +1 Fortitude and +2 to death saves and saves against unconsciousness.
Shadow Jaunt is a move action once per encounter. Teleport 3 squares, then remain insubstantial until the start of your next turn.

species.name: Cayma
species.sourceLocator: Character Creation / Lizard Kin / Caymas as PCs
traits: Tiny lizard kin of Cay, typically 12–18 inches tall and 6–10 pounds. Their dark eyes have no visible pupil. They speak a Shazak dialect, and some also speak Common.

Ability adjustments are +2 Dexterity, −1 Strength and −1 Wisdom. Infravision 90 feet. Swimming is a bonus proficiency. A Cayma can also take Architecture or Engineering as a bonus proficiency at half the normal proficiency score, rounded down.
Class limits are fighter 8, wizard 12, priest 8, thief 14 and optional psionicist 8. Fighter/thief and thief/psionicist are the allowed combinations.

Cayma thieves apply −10 Pick Pockets, +10 Open Locks, +5 Find/Remove Traps, +10 Move Silently and +10 Hide in Shadows, in percentage points. The Savage Warrior kit separately grants detect magic within 10 feet once a day per level.

species.name: Ee’aar
species.sourceLocator: Character Creation / Ee’aar and Enduks / Ee’aar as PCs
traits: Winged elves from Aeryl who speak Aeryla, an Elvish dialect. Ability adjustments are +2 Dexterity and −2 Constitution. Infravision extends 60 feet and daylight vision can distinguish details over a mile away. Starting characters gain no initial Legacy.

Fly 18 at maneuverability B while carrying up to half body weight, or C with a load up to body weight. Leather, studded leather and glassteel elven chain are compatible with flight. Ee’aar never use shields. Check Constitution hourly during flight, with a −1 for carrying more than half body weight, +4 while gliding in favorable wind and −1 per 5,000 feet above the first 5,000. Ceiling 20,000 feet. Failure requires half an hour of rest per two hours of prior flight.

Wing AC is 9 improved by Dexterity. Back attacks target the wings. A flank miss can hit if it beats wing AC, and a frontal attack can target the wings if the attacker is taller. At 50% HP lost only gliding is possible. At 75% lost gliding also ends. A standing jump reaches 10 feet. A qualifying fire hit or failed save ignites the wings unless extinguished in 1d4 rounds. Burned wings cause 2d6 additional damage and ground the character for one month.

Gain +1 to attack with a shortsword, bolas or lasso, and 30% resistance to sleep and charm spells. An adult carries a chest light that can be switched on, off or made to flicker at will. Enclosed confinement calls for a daily Wisdom check. Failures cause distress until open air. Five failures in one confinement require heal or cure disease.

Class limits are fighter 14, wizard 15, priest 12, thief 8, bard 10 and optional psionicist 7. Allowed combinations pair two of fighter, wizard and priest. The PC rules forbid longbows and make medium or large slashing weapons ineffective.
Ee’aar thieves apply −5 Open Locks, +5 Find/Remove Traps, −5 Hide in Shadows, +15 Detect Noise and −20 Climb Walls. These are percentage-point adjustments.

species.name: Enduk
species.sourceLocator: Character Creation / Ee’aar and Enduks / Enduks as PCs / The Enduk Pantheon
traits: Bull-headed, feather-winged folk of Eshu who speak Nimmurian. Most stand 6–7 feet tall. Those over 7 feet count as Large. Ability adjustments are +2 Strength and −2 Dexterity. Daylight vision can distinguish details up to half a mile away.

Natural AC 6. Most light armor gives AC 5. The horns deal 1d4+1 damage. At 1st level an Enduk takes a mace or club proficiency. Proficiency with other piercing or slashing melee arms waits until level 3, with a flight-lance exception. Both longbows and shortbows are forbidden, and medium or large slashing weapons are unwieldy.

Fly 12 at maneuverability C with a load up to body weight, or D up to twice body weight. Flight requires bronze plate or lighter and has a 10,000-foot ceiling. After three turns of flight, check Constitution each turn. Failure requires one turn of rest per three turns already flown.

Gliding replaces flight after losing at least half normal HP, and ends at 75% HP loss. Fire exposure calls for immediate extinguishing for 1d4 rounds. If feathers burn, take 2d6 additional damage and lose flight for one month. Enclosed spaces cause no special hindrance.

Class limits are fighter 14, wizard 12, unlimited priest, thief 8, bard 9 and optional psionicist 8. Fighter/priest, fighter/psionicist and priest/psionicist are available, with twice the ordinary chance of a wild talent when psionics are in play.
Enduk thieves apply −5 Hide in Shadows, +5 Detect Noise, −20 Climb Walls and +10 Read Languages. These are percentage-point adjustments.

species.name: Gurrash
species.sourceLocator: Character Creation / Savage Warrior / Lizard Kin / Gurrash as PCs
traits: Large alligator-headed lizard kin of Ator, commonly seven to eight feet tall. They speak a Shazak dialect. Ability adjustments are +2 Strength, +1 Constitution, −2 Wisdom and −2 Charisma.
Natural AC 5 and Swimming as a bonus proficiency. Only starting gurrash wizards can take Reading/Writing.

Frustration or confusion, or at least 8 damage in a single hit, triggers a Wisdom check at −2. On a failure the Gurrash fights for up to five rounds with the courage effects of the emotion spell. Removing the frustration can end a frustration-triggered rage. A wound-triggered rage targets the attacker and ends early only by magic or the target’s death.

Class limits are fighter 15, wizard 6, priest 7, thief 9 and optional psionicist 7. Fighter/priest and fighter/thief are available. Priests must be Shamans or War Priests. The Savage Warrior kit separately grants its 10-foot intrusion alarm.
Gurrash thieves apply −5 Pick Pockets, −10 Open Locks, +5 Find/Remove Traps, +5 Move Silently, +5 Hide in Shadows, +5 Detect Noise and −10 Read Languages. These are percentage-point adjustments.

species.name: Manscorpion
species.sourceLocator: Character Creation / Nimmur and the Manscorpions / Manscorpions as PCs
traits: The standard PC is an Um-Shedu manscorpion whose sunlight curse was lifted after aiding the Enduks. The DM can allow a redemption-seeking character who still bears the curse.

Ability adjustments are +1 Strength and Constitution and −1 Intelligence and Wisdom. Um-Shedu adjust effective Charisma by −1 with other humanoids and −4 with demihumans or humans. Nimmurian is the usual language.

Natural AC 7 and infravision. Body armor rated 7 or worse gives AC 6. For armor rated 6 or better, improve its AC by 1. Shields and Dexterity modify normally. They cannot swim. Choose bonus Artistic Ability or Charioteering. Astronomy and Astrology are unavailable at character creation.

The Um-Shedu sting uses sleep venom. A target failing a poison save is woozy for one round, then sleeps for 2d8 rounds. Neutralize poison can awaken the target early. The save penalty is −1 per three character levels, capped at −4. Um-Shedu are immune to other manscorpions’ venom and gain +2 on other poison saves.

Class limits are fighter 12, wizard 12, priest 12, thief 7, bard 10 and optional psionicist 7. Fighter/thief, fighter/priest and fighter/psionicist are available. Starting priests serve Idu or Ilsundal. Wizard specialization is unavailable.
Manscorpion thieves apply +5 Open Locks, −20 Move Silently, −5 Hide in Shadows, +5 Detect Noise and −25 Climb Walls. These are percentage-point adjustments.

species.name: Phanaton
species.sourceLocator: The Phanatons of Jibarú: Phanatons as PCs
traits: Small furred humanoid with a grasping ringed tail and gliding membranes. No infravision. Natural AC 9, improved by a racial 2-point bonus before Dexterity. +2 on all saving throws.
Strength −2 and Intelligence −1. Dexterity +2, or Dexterity and Wisdom +1 each for shamans. The PC section requires Dexterity 16, despite the general table listing a minimum of 6.

Glide 50 feet per round, with maximum horizontal range equal to three times the starting height. Reduce range by 20 feet per 100 coin-weight carried. Armor or shield use prevents gliding. While gliding, the character cannot fight, use somatic spell components, or perform tasks that need two hands.

At 3rd level, favorable winds allow level flight or a climb of 10 feet per 60 feet of travel in normal winds, or per 30 feet in strong breezes. High winds prevent controlled flight. At 7th level, use pass plant once per day.
Charisma is reduced by 1 with most other humanoids and by 2 with humans and non-elven demihumans. Treat Charisma as 3 when dealing with araneas. Speak Jibar, which uses gestures and vocalizations.

Class limits through fighter 9, ranger 10, mage 8, priest 10, druid 13, thief 15, bard 8, and optional psionicist 7 per Table 1.7. The character prose omits bard. Multiclass choices are fighter/thief, ranger/priest, and fighter/psionicist.

species.name: Shazak
species.sourceLocator: Other People, Other Places: The Lizard Kin, Shazaks as PCs
traits: Medium lizard kin, usually six to seven feet tall. Tough scales provide natural AC 5. Swimming is a bonus nonweapon proficiency. Speak Shazak, a language closely related to Malpheggi.
Strength +1 and Wisdom −1. Before adjustments, Strength 8–18, Constitution 6–18, Intelligence 3–17, and Charisma 3–16. Dexterity and Wisdom range from 3 to 18.

Class limits through fighter 12, wizard 7, priest 10, thief 11, bard 8, and optional psionicist 9. Fighter/thief and fighter/psionicist are the two multiclass combinations. The home culture restricts access to kits.
Thieving adjustments are −5 percentage points to pick pockets, open locks, climb walls, and read languages, and +5 each to move silently, hide in shadows, and detect noise.

species.name: Wallara
species.sourceLocator: Wallara and the Chameleonmen: Wallaras as PCs
traits: Slender, mottled humanoid with natural AC 9 and no infravision. Strength −1. Dexterity +1 for most characters, or Wisdom +1 for a Mendoo. No initial Legacy in Wallara.
Vanish as a full action on a successful Intelligence check. The jump works like dimension door out to 120 feet and cannot place the wallara inside a solid object. It can be attempted every round.
