From 3rd level, blending makes the wallara effectively invisible to other peoples while completely silent and immobile. It can be used at will for up to one hour per level at a time. Other wallaras can see through it. Armor disables both vanish and blending.

Bonus Tracking with a −3 adjustment in place of the normal −6, plus Ancient History and Local History. Can find the way home within 10 miles. Speak Risil. Apply a Charisma penalty of 1 with other humanoids or 2 with humans and demihumans.

Class table lists fighter 12, ranger 15, wizard 10, priest 10, thief 11, bard 10, and optional psionicist 9. The character prose omits bard. Wizards are limited to diviner, abjurer, or necromancer. Wallaras use their cultural kits and cannot multiclass.

species.name: Lupin
species.publication: Savage Coast Campaign Book, Part 2: Player Characters
species.sourceLocator: Player Characters: Character Races, New Character Races, Lupins
traits: Medium, dog-headed humanoid with base AC 10, infravision 60 feet, and keen hearing and scent. Strength and Constitution +1, Intelligence and Wisdom −1. Raw Strength and Constitution must be at least 8.

Automatically gain Blind-fighting. Tracking uses half Wisdom rounded up, full Wisdom if learned through slots, or Wisdom +6 as a ranger. Detect Noise begins at 35%, adding 2 percentage points per level after 1st. Thieves can invest skill points in it.

A save at +4 can detect the presence of an invisible or ethereal being. Check as soon as one approaches to within 10 feet, then each round it stays that close. The save alone gives neither exact position nor a way to affect an ethereal creature.

Recognize werewolves in any form 99% of the time and other lupins in unusual forms 15% of the time. Identify a familiar species by scent automatically or a familiar individual with an Intelligence check. Masking odors can impose −1 to −4.

Take −2 on saves against sound or odor attacks. Swallowed wolfsbane acts as Type J poison, fatal on failure and inflicting 20 HP on a successful save. Injected wolfsbane acts as Type P, halving ability scores for 1d3 days on a failed save. Natural bite deals 1d4, speed 3, with a proficiency slot needed to avoid the nonproficiency penalty.

Class limits through fighter 13, unlimited ranger, wizard 12, cleric 15, druid 13, thief 13, and bard 9. No paladin. Lupin or Renardois is the native-language choice. Common is suggested as an additional starting language.

species.name: Rakasta
species.publication: Savage Coast Campaign Book, Part 2: Player Characters
species.sourceLocator: Player Characters: Character Races, New Character Races, Rakastas
traits: Medium feline humanoid with natural AC 10 and infravision 60 feet. Dexterity +2 and Wisdom −2. Raw Strength must be at least 9 and Dexterity at least 8.

Halve damage from falls. Gain Blind-fighting automatically. Detect Noise starts at 20%, including the racial bonus, and a thief may add points to it. Take −1 on saving throws against sound-based attacks.

Save at +4 to notice an invisible or ethereal being as it approaches within 10 feet and in every round it stays there. This reveals presence and whether it is ethereal. Locating or affecting it requires other means.

Natural bite 1d4, speed 2. Front claws 1d2 each, speed 1. Bare rear claws 1d3 each, speed 3, after grappling or securing a hold with both front claws. Natural attacks use Strength and separate proficiencies for bite, front claws, and rear claws.

Front-claw proficiency grants war-claw proficiency. A worn pair grants one extra attack per round and incurs no two-weapon penalties for a character who has natural claws. Speed 1 with natural claws. Each war claw deals 1d4 against small or medium targets or 1d3 against large targets in place of the natural claw damage.
Class limits through fighter 15, ranger 11, wizard 15, cleric 12, druid 13, thief 15, and unlimited bard. No paladin. Speak Rakastan. Common is suggested as an additional starting language.

species.name: Alseid
traits: Medium Monstrosity. Walk 40 ft. Dexterity +2, Wisdom +1 and darkvision 60 ft.
Alseid Weapon Training gives proficiency with spears and shortbows. Light Hooves gives Stealth proficiency.
Quadruped. Squeeze through trapdoors, manholes and similar openings that a Medium Humanoid could traverse normally. Ladders, stairs and similar routes count as difficult terrain.
Woodfriend. Leave no tracks and automatically know true north while in a forest.
Speak, read and write Common and Elvish.

species.name: Erina
traits: Small. Walk 25 ft. Dexterity +2, plus Wisdom or Charisma +1. Darkvision 60 ft.
Hardy. Resist poison damage and roll saving throws against poison with advantage.
Spines. At the start of your turn, a creature you are grappling or that is grappling you takes 1d4 piercing damage.
Keen Senses gives Perception proficiency. Digger gives 20 ft. of burrowing speed through earth and sand. Mud, ice and rock block this movement.
Speak Erina and either Common or Sylvan.

species.name: Piney
traits: Medium Humanoid. Walk 30 ft. Constitution +2, Wisdom +1 and darkvision 60 ft.
Margreve Within. Meet daily food needs through ordinary food or 30 minutes of direct sunlight. Resist poison damage and roll saving throws against poison with advantage.
Margreve Without. Choose a plantlike feature, such as cracked bark skin or creaking wooden joints, or agree on another feature with the GM.
Roots gives Nature and Survival proficiency. Speak, read and write Common and speak unwritten Piney.

species.name: Ravenfolk
traits: Sublime Ravenfolk. Medium. Walk 30 ft. Dexterity +2 and Charisma +1.
Constant Tune gives advantage on saves against charm and fear. Cosmic Musician gives Performance proficiency and proficiency with one instrument of your choice.

Sublime Chord. As an action, creatures able to hear you within 30 ft. make a DC 13 Charisma save. On failure they treat you as a casual friend and are charmed by you for 10 minutes. A creature has advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. Recharge on a long rest.
Speak, read and write Common, Ravenfolk and Umbral.

species.name: Trollkin
species.sourceLocator: Trollkin Traits, Night Whisper Trollkin and Stonehide Trollkin, pp. 29–30
traits: Medium. Walk 30 ft. Constitution +2. Darkvision 60 ft. Legacy of Fear gives Intimidation proficiency. Speak, read and write Northern Tongue.
Natural Weapons. Unarmed claws deal 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing. Unarmed fangs deal 1d4 + Strength modifier piercing.

Inhuman Vigor. As a bonus action, spend one Hit Die to recover HP just as on a short rest. The maximum spend rises to two dice at level 6, three at level 12 and four at level 18. Recharge on a long rest. After taking acid or fire damage, the trait is unavailable until a short or long rest.
Night Whisper. Wisdom +1. Once per long rest, announce Spirit Whispers before rolling an ability check or saving throw to roll with advantage.
Stonehide. Strength +1. Thick Hide gives a +1 bonus to AC.

species.name: Tosculi
species.sourceLocator: Tosculi (Hiveless) Traits and Alternate Racial Traits, pp. 7–9
traits: The playable Tosculi are Hiveless. Small, walking speed 30 ft. Increase one physical score and one mental score by 2 each. Reduce any score by 2, including either score just increased. Most reach adulthood at 13 and few live past 40.
Natural Armor sets a minimum AC of 11 + Dexterity modifier even while wearing armor. Natural Attacks grants proficiency with claws that deal 1d4 slashing damage.
Gliding Wings prevents falling damage and grants a 40 ft. fly speed without hovering. Finish each round of flight at least one-quarter of the distance traveled below the starting elevation or fall.
Stalker grants proficiency in Perception and Stealth. Speak, read, and write Tosculi and one other language, commonly Southern.

Binding Spittle replaces Stalker. As an Attack action, make a proficient ranged attack against a Medium or smaller target within 60 ft. On a hit the target is restrained. The target or an adjacent creature can use an action for a Strength check to free it, DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier. Breaking the spittle also frees the target (AC 10, bludgeoning damage equal to half your level plus Constitution modifier). One use per short or long rest.
Bite replaces Stalker. Use a 1d6 slashing bite as an unarmed strike. After a hit, you can try to grapple the target as a bonus action. The bite die becomes 2d6 at level 11.
Latent Hive Mind replaces Gliding Wings. Learn a psionic, component-free message that works in magical silence. At level 3, you can also cast component-free detect thoughts once per long rest.
Hardened Carapace replaces both Gliding Wings and Natural Armor and raises the minimum AC to 11 + Constitution modifier + Dexterity modifier.

species.name: Jinnborn
species.sourceLocator: Jinnborn Traits, Speaker Jinnborn and Shaper Jinnborn, pp. 10–12
traits: Medium, walking speed 30 ft., Constitution +2, darkvision 60 ft. and proficiency in Persuasion. Reach adulthood at 16 and can live past 150.
Desert Dependent requires a DC 15 Charisma save for each month spent away from the desert. Failure brings indefinite madness. Determine the effect with the DM or use the rules table.

Choose a siraati and speak, read, and write Common and its matching elemental language. Air pairs Auran with lightning, earth pairs Terran with acid, fire pairs Ignan with fire, and water pairs Aquan with cold.

Speaker grants Wisdom +1. Favor of the Jinn can grant advantage on one of your saves or ability checks or impose disadvantage on an attack against you. Declare it before the roll. Uses equal Wisdom modifier, minimum one, and refresh on a long rest.
Speaker also grants Walker, giving advantage on saving throws against being stunned and against extreme environments, plus on ability checks to navigate the wilderness or avoid getting lost.

Shaper grants Strength +1 and resistance to your siraati damage type. On a melee hit on your turn you can add 1d6 damage of the same type, once on that turn. Uses equal Constitution modifier, minimum one, and refresh on a long rest.

species.name: Ramag
traits: Medium, walking speed 30 ft., Intelligence +2 and Dexterity +1. Reach adulthood at 15 and can live to 90.
Arcane Heritage lets you disregard an item's class requirements when attuning to it.
Mystical Understanding grants Arcana proficiency. Spell Damping grants advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves against spells.
Speak, read, and write Common and Giant.

species.name: Kijani
traits: Medium Plant, walking speed 30 ft. and darkvision 60 ft. Wisdom +2 and one different ability score +1. Reach adulthood at 12 and live up to 40 years.

Contained Fury is available while current HP is below half your maximum. Once per turn on a weapon hit you can add 1d4 damage of the weapon's type. When a visible attacker hits you, you can use a reaction for +2 AC against that attack.
Plantborn grants immunity to sleep effects and dormancy during a long rest. Starting at level 7, you can cast speak with plants at spell level 3 once per long rest using Wisdom.
Roots of the Past grants one proficiency from Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion. Speak, read, and write Common and Sylvan.

species.name: Satarre
traits: Unbound Satarre are Medium, walk 30 ft., and have darkvision to 60 ft. Constitution +2 and Wisdom +1.
Keeper of Secrets grants Arcana proficiency, advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks about planes or planar travel, and proficiency in History, Insight, or Religion.

Portal Sense reveals the direction and distance to the nearest nonmagical entrance or exit while in a confined area. It grants advantage on Investigation or Perception checks to find hidden or invisible doors and magical portals.

Unraveling Touch is an action once per long rest, targeting one creature you can see within 30 ft. It makes a Constitution save against DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + proficiency bonus. On a failure it spends its action each turn repeating the save until it succeeds.
Speak, read, and write Umbral plus one of Abyssal, Infernal, or Void Speech.

species.name: Lamia
traits: Medium Monstrosity. Strength +2, Charisma +1, walk 30 ft., climb 20 ft., swim 20 ft., and darkvision to 60 ft.
Dangerous Beauty grants proficiency in Deception and Intimidation.
Serpent Strike gives advantage on attacks against creatures you surprised or creatures charmed by you or an ally.
Snake Body gives advantage on checks and saves against being knocked prone. Effects and equipment that require legs or feet confer no benefit.
Speak, read, and write Abyssal and Common.

species.name: Mushroomfolk
traits: Humanoid. Wisdom +2, walk 30 ft., and darkvision to 60 ft. Choose Acid Cap, Favored, or Morel to determine size and additional traits.
Fungoid Form grants advantage on saves against poison, resistance to poison damage, and immunity to disease. Hardy Survivor grants proficiency in Survival.
Speak, read, and write Mushroomfolk and either Common or Undercommon.

Acid Cap is Medium, adds Strength +1, and grants acid resistance and Athletics proficiency. When a melee weapon attack hits you from within 5 ft., you can react to deal acid damage equal to half your level rounded up to the attacker. Uses equal your Constitution modifier, minimum one, per long rest.

Favored is Medium, adds Charisma +1, and grants Persuasion proficiency. You know Spare the Dying and can cast Bless from level 3 once per long rest. Both use Charisma. Restful Spores add your proficiency bonus to HP recovered with Hit Dice at the end of a short rest by you and friendly creatures within 30 ft. Each beneficiary can receive that bonus once per long rest.

Morel is Small, adds Dexterity +1, walks 35 ft., and gains Stealth proficiency. After adjusting coloration for at least a minute in a setting rich in naturally occurring plants or fungi, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks there for 24 hours.

species.name: Aranea
traits: Seven-level monster class. Begins as a Medium spider with +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, land speed 30 ft., climb speed 25 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and Common and Sylvan. Gains +8 on Climb checks and can take 10 while threatened. Proficient with simple weapons. Favored class Aranea.

The bite begins at 1d4 and advances to 1d6 at level 3, adding 1½ times the Strength bonus. Poison is two instances of Strength damage, each 1d3 at level 1, 1d6 at level 4, and 2d6 at level 6. Fortitude DC is 10 + half the Hit Dice from class levels + Constitution modifier.

Hybrid shape begins at 3/day for 1 hour and becomes at will at level 3. At level 5 choose one fixed Small or Medium humanoid form, usable 3/day for 1 hour and at will by level 7. Humanoid form provides the chosen form's racial abilities while preserving the aranea's ability scores and casting. Bite poison and webbing work in spider or hybrid form.
Casts as a sorcerer of level 1, 2, or 3 at aranea levels 2, 4, or 6. Web is a standard-action netlike attack starting at level 5 (3/day), increasing to 6/day at level 7.
At the end of the class the aranea has 3d8 Hit Dice, ECL 7, CR 4, BAB +3, and base saves +3/+3/+1. Its land speed reaches 50 ft.

species.name: Annis Hag
traits: Twelve-level monster class. Starts with +2 Strength, speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., Common and Giant. Favored class Annis Hag. Steely Skin reduces slashing or piercing weapon damage by 1 per hit and increases bludgeoning weapon damage by 1 per hit. A mixed bludgeoning weapon counts as bludgeoning.

Starts with two 1d4 claws and +4 natural armor. Adds a secondary bite at level 2. Claws reach 1d6 at level 6 and the bite reaches 1d6 at level 9. Its claws add the full Strength bonus and its bite adds half.

Change self starts at level 2 and fog cloud at level 6, both 1/day. Change self increases to 3/day at level 11 and fog cloud at level 12. Caster level equals Hit Dice from class levels. Spell resistance begins at level 5 and equals 7 + annis hag class level.

Large with 10-ft. reach at level 8, speed 40 ft. at level 9. Starts a free grapple after a qualifying claw hit at level 10. Rend starts at level 11 and adds the damage of two claws after both claws hit. Tear at level 12 hits a held foe with all melee attacks each round the hag maintains the hold.
Finishes at ECL 12, CR 4, 7d8 Hit Dice, BAB +7/+2, and base saves +2/+5/+5.

species.name: Barghest
traits: Twelve-level monster class. Starts with +2 Strength and +2 Constitution, land speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and Goblin, Infernal, and Worg. Proficient with simple and martial weapons. Favored class Barghest.

Begins with a 1d6 bite, +2 natural armor, and Feed. After slaying a humanoid, consume its body and life force as a full-round action for a +2 enhancement bonus to Constitution for one day. Resurrection needing a body fails. Wish, miracle, and true resurrection each have a 50% chance to fail.

At level 2 gains 1d4 claws and scent 10 ft. A standard action shifts into wolf or goblin form. In wolf form, move at 60 ft., gain +4 circumstance to Hide, and use pass without trace as a free action. Scent increases at levels 5 and 8.

Levitate, misdirection, and project image each begin at 1/day at level 3, increase to 3/day at level 6, and become at will at level 11. Charm monster, charm person, dimension door, and emotion each are 1/day from level 7. Caster level equals class Hit Dice. Save DC 10 + spell level + Charisma modifier.
DR 5/+1 begins at level 5 and becomes DR 10/+1 at level 12. Finishes at ECL 12, CR 4, 6d8 Hit Dice, BAB +6/+1, base saves +5/+5/+5, and +6 natural armor.

species.name: Djinni
traits: Thirteen-level monster class. Begins with +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, land speed 20 ft., perfect flight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and telepathy to 100 ft. with creatures that have a language. Speaks Auran, Celestial, Common, and Ignan. Proficient with simple and martial weapons. Favored class Djinni.

Acid resistance starts at 5 at level 2, rising to 10 at 5th, 15 at 8th, 20 at 11th, and immunity at 13th. Air Mastery applies a −1 circumstance penalty to airborne foes' attack and damage rolls. Self-only invisibility is at will from level 3.
At level 4 gains a 1d4 slam that adds 1½ times the Strength bonus and uses iterative BAB attacks, plus whirlwind 1/day. Whirlwind rises to 3/day at level 8 and at will at level 12.

Plane shift begins at level 5 with two solo trips per day. Passenger capacity grows to one at level 7, three at level 10, and six at level 12 when plane shift becomes at will. Other daily spell-like powers arrive at 6th and 9th level. Their caster level is Hit Dice from class levels +13.
Flight reaches 60 ft. (perfect) at level 7. Large size with 10-ft. reach starts at level 9. Finishes at ECL 13, CR 5, 7d8 Hit Dice, BAB +7/+2, and base saves +5/+5/+5.

species.name: Drider
traits: Ten-level monster class. Starts with +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, +2 Charisma, land speed 30 ft., climb speed 15 ft., and darkvision 120 ft. Speaks Common, Elven, and Undercommon. Gains +8 on Climb and may take 10 while threatened. Favored class Drider.

Choose Cleric, Sorcerer, or Wizard spellcasting and proficiencies at level 1. Cast as a member of that class of the drider's Hit Dice. Clerics of Lolth can choose Chaos, Destruction, Evil, or Trickery domains.

The bite starts at level 2 and deals 1d4 plus half the Strength bonus. Injury poison deals temporary Strength damage at first exposure and again after 1 minute. Both rolls are 1d3 at level 2, 1d4 at level 5, and 1d6 at level 9. Fortitude DC 10 + half the Hit Dice from class levels + Constitution modifier.

Daily spell-like abilities start at level 3. The list covers detection and divination, dancing lights, darkness, dispel magic, faerie fire, levitate, and suggestion. Caster level equals Hit Dice from class levels. Save DC 10 + Charisma modifier + spell level.
Spell resistance begins at level 6 and equals 4 + drider class level. Large size at level 8. Finishes at ECL 10, CR 7, 6d8 Hit Dice, BAB +4, and base saves +2/+2/+5.

species.name: Efreeti
traits: Medium outsider at entry with the Evil, Fire, and Lawful subtypes. Starts with +2 Strength and +2 Constitution, a 20-ft. land speed, darkvision 60 ft., and telepathy with creatures that have a language within 100 ft.
Fire immunity. Apply −10 to saves against cold attacks and double damage when cold offers no save.

Proficient with simple and martial weapons. The slam starts at 1d4 plus 1½ times the Strength bonus and explicitly gains iterative attacks from BAB. Heat starts at level 2 and adds fire damage on a slam hit, on a successful grapple, and each round a hold is maintained.
Level 2 grants +2 natural armor, detect magic 1/day, and enlarge 1/day. Level 3 grants another +2 Strength and produce flame and pyrotechnics at will. Spell-like caster level is class HD +8.

At level 4 the Efreeti can fly 40 ft. with perfect maneuverability and use invisibility 1/day. The class later grants plane shift, gaseous form, polymorph self, wall of fire, permanent image, and wish. It becomes Large with 10-ft. reach at level 10.
Auran, Common, Ignan, and Infernal are automatic languages. The preferred progression is Efreeti. The class ends at ECL 19 with 10d8 Hit Dice and a printed CR of 8.

species.name: Flamebrother Salamander
traits: Small fire outsider, +2 Intelligence and +2 Wisdom, land speed 20 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and +4 racial on Craft (metalworking). Small size gives +1 AC and attacks, +4 Hide, and three-quarters of Medium carrying capacity.

Proficient with simple and martial weapons. Treats the metal salamander halfspear as martial. Natural attacks and attacks with metal weapons add heat damage, which starts at 1d2, rises to 1d4 at level 2, and reaches 1d6 at level 7.
The tail slap starts at 1d4 plus half the Strength bonus before heat. At level 4 a successful grapple check against a target of up to Medium size can deal tail slap damage with heat.
Fire damage immunity. Apply −10 to saves against cold attacks, and double damage if a cold attack offers no save.
Ignan is automatic. Favored class Flamebrother. At the end of the class the character is ECL 7 with 3d8 Hit Dice, +7 natural armor, and a printed CR of 2.

species.name: Athach
traits: Medium aberration at entry, 30-ft. land speed, darkvision 60 ft., and starting adjustments of −4 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, and −4 Charisma. Proficient with simple weapons and light armor.

Three Arms starts at level 1. Only the primary weapon arm gets iterative attacks. Extra weapon arms add half the Strength bonus to damage and use the two-weapon penalties. Multiweapon Fighting and Multidexterity reduce those penalties.

A 1d4 bite arrives at level 2 and gains Strength poison at level 3. The poison save DC is 10 + half monster-class HD + Constitution modifier. Initial and secondary damage are both 1d4 Strength at level 3. Bite size and poison damage improve with progression.

Rock throwing begins at level 8. Level 9 grants Large size, reach 10 ft., and bonus Multiattack. At level 19 the class ends at Huge, 50-ft. land speed, 15-ft. reach, 14d8 Hit Dice, ECL 19, and printed CR 7.
Giant is automatic. Favored class Athach.

species.name: Grig
traits: Tiny fey, starting adjustments −6 Strength and +6 Dexterity, land speed 20 ft., fly 20 ft. (poor), 2½-ft. face, 0-ft. reach, and low-light vision. Tiny size gives +2 on attack rolls and AC and +8 Hide.
Racial bonuses are +2 Listen, Search, and Spot, +8 Jump, and +5 Move Silently in forests. Class weapon proficiencies cover simple weapons, the composite longbow, and the short sword.
Change self, entangle, invisibility on self, pyrotechnics, and ventriloquism begin at 1/day each as a 9th-level sorcerer. Spell resistance equals 13 + Grig class level.

At level 2, flight increases to 40 ft. (poor) and the Grig gains +2 Wisdom and bonus Dodge. Level 3 adds +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, and +1 natural armor. Level 4 adds +2 Charisma, raises natural armor to +2 and spell-like uses to 3/day each, and unlocks attune fiddle.

A level-4 Grig who has selected fiddle as a Perform mode can attune a properly sized fiddle in one day. While playing it, nonsprites within 30 ft. make a DC 15 Will save or dance for as long as the playing continues. Only its attuned player can use this magic. Separation for more than one week requires a new attunement.
Common and Sylvan are automatic. Favored class Grig. ECL 4, a half d6, and printed CR 1 at the end of the monster class.

species.name: Harpy
traits: Medium monstrous humanoid at entry, +2 Dexterity, −4 Intelligence, +2 Charisma. Base land speed 20 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and Common. Favored class Harpy.

Proficient with simple weapons. The class begins with +1 natural armor and two claws dealing 1d3 each plus half the Strength bonus. Gain another +2 Dexterity at level 2 and a 40-ft. fly speed (average) at level 3.

Captivating Song starts at level 4 in a 10-ft. radius and expands to 30, 100, and 300 ft. at levels 6, 8, and 10. It affects nonharpies who fail Will DC 10 + half the Harpy’s class HD + Charisma modifier. It lasts while the Harpy sings and for another round per class HD.
Flight rises to 60 ft. at level 5 and 80 ft. at level 8, with average maneuverability. At ECL 10 the progression ends with 7d8 Hit Dice and a printed CR of 4.

species.name: Kyton
traits: Medium outsider with a 30-ft. land speed, darkvision 60 ft., immunity to cold, and a +8 racial bonus on Craft (metalworking). Starts with +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, and −4 Intelligence. Speaks Common and Infernal.

The 14-level monster class grants the evil and lawful subtypes and proficiency with simple and martial weapons and the spiked chain. It grants no armor or shield proficiency. Body chains add no equipment weight.

At 1st level the kyton can use two body chains at its full attack bonus. They start at 1d6 + Strength modifier each and threaten both adjacent targets and targets 10 ft. away. The class improves natural armor and chain damage as it advances.

Unnerving Gaze starts at 3rd level with a 5-ft. range. On a failed Will save, an enemy takes a −1 morale penalty to attacks for 1d3 rounds. Save DC is 10 + half the kyton’s class Hit Dice + Charisma modifier. Each enemy is subject to that kyton’s gaze once per day.

Dancing Chains starts at 4th level with one unattended chain within 20 ft. The kyton can lengthen a controlled chain by up to 15 ft., make it grow barbs, attack with it once per round, or climb it at normal speed.

species.name: Lillend
traits: Starts as a Medium outsider with 20-ft. land speed, darkvision 60 ft., poison immunity, and a +4 racial bonus on Survival. Starts with +2 Wisdom and +2 Charisma. Speaks Abyssal, Celestial, Common, and Infernal.

The 13-level monster class grants chaotic and good subtypes, proficiency with simple and martial weapons, and gradually improves natural armor. It grants no armor or shield proficiency. Fire resistance starts at class level 4.

From class level 2 a lillend casts spells and uses bardic music as a bard of half its monster class level. At level 3 it gains darkness, hallucinatory terrain, knock, and light once per day each. At level 5 it gains charm person, speak with animals, and speak with plants once per day each. These spell-like abilities use its effective bard level +4 as caster level.

The tail slap begins at level 3. At level 5 a tail hit against a creature no larger than the lillend can start a grapple and constrict. Constricting occupies its lower body, so it cannot take move actions while maintaining the hold.
Flight begins at class level 6 at 70 ft. with average maneuverability. Large size and 10-ft. reach arrive at level 8.

species.name: Medusa
traits: Medium monstrous humanoid with 30-ft. land speed and 60-ft. darkvision. Starts with +2 Dexterity and +2 Charisma. Speaks Common.
The 10-level monster class grants proficiency with simple weapons and the shortbow. It grants no armor or shield proficiency. Natural armor begins at class level 2.

Snake hair attacks one creature as a unit. It starts at 1d4 + half Strength modifier and carries poison. The Fortitude save DC is 10 + half the medusa’s class Hit Dice + Constitution modifier. The class table gives the primary and secondary Strength damage at each tier.

Petrifying Gaze starts at level 6 as one deliberate use per day against one target within 10 ft. At level 8 it becomes three daily uses within 30 ft. The mature 30-ft. gaze comes at level 10. The Fortitude save DC is 10 + half the medusa’s class Hit Dice + Charisma modifier.

species.name: Nixie
traits: Small aquatic fey that breathes air and water. Walks 20 ft., swims 30 ft., and has low-light vision. Starts with −4 Strength, +4 Dexterity, and +4 Charisma. Speaks Aquan, Common, and Sylvan.

Small size gives +1 AC and attack rolls and +4 on Hide checks. Lifting and carrying limits are half those of a Medium character. Nixies gain racial bonuses of +2 on Search, Spot, and Listen, +5 on Hide in water, and +8 on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. They can take 10 on Swim checks.
The four-level monster class grants proficiency with simple weapons and the short sword. It grants no armor or shield proficiency.

Water breathing starts at level 1, once daily at caster level equal to class level +2. Charm person starts at level 2, once daily at caster level equal to class level. It reaches three uses per day at level 4. Dodge arrives at level 3 and spell resistance 16 at level 4.

species.name: Sea Hag
traits: Starts as a Medium aquatic monstrous humanoid. Walks 30 ft., swims 40 ft., breathes air or water, and sees in darkness to 60 ft. Starts with +2 Strength and +2 Wisdom. Speaks Common and Giant.
Gains +8 on Swim checks to perform special actions or avoid hazards, can always take 10, and can run in a straight line while swimming.
The monster class grants two natural claws at 1st level and proficiency with simple weapons. It grants no armor or shield proficiency. The claws begin at 1d4 + Strength modifier each.

Horrific Appearance starts at class level 2. A creature looking at the hag takes 1 point of Strength damage on a failed Fortitude save. The DC is 10 + half the hag’s class Hit Dice + Charisma modifier. A successful save protects the creature from that hag’s horrific appearance for one day. Later tiers increase the Strength damage.
Spell resistance begins at class level 5 at 11 + class Hit Dice. The sea hag grows to Large with a 10-ft. reach at level 6.

species.name: Umber Hulk
traits: A 14-level aberration monster class. Starts Medium with 20-ft. land speed, darkvision 60 ft., +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, and −2 Intelligence. Speaks Umber Hulk and is proficient with simple weapons.
Starts with two claws, a bite, and +3 natural armor. Claws add full Strength and the secondary bite adds half. Natural armor rises to +5 at 4th level and +7 at 7th.
Gains tremorsense at 4th level (10 ft.) and burrow 20 ft. at 5th. By the end of the progression, tremorsense locates creatures or objects touching the ground within 60 ft.

Confusing Gaze starts with a 5-ft. radius at 7th level, rising to 30 ft. at 13th. It applies confusion at caster level 8 on a failed Will save. DC equals 10 + half the class Hit Dice + Charisma modifier.
Becomes Large with 10-ft. reach at 9th level. At 14th level the class has 8d8 Hit Dice, ECL 14, and CR 7.

species.name: Air Elemental
traits: A 14-level elemental monster class. Starts Small with +4 Dexterity and −4 Intelligence, fly speed 100 ft. (perfect), darkvision 60 ft., and Auran.
Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, and critical hits. Starts with +3 natural armor, a slam that adds 1½ times Strength, and bonus Flyby Attack and Improved Initiative.
At 2nd level gains bonus Weapon Finesse (slam), Air Mastery, and Whirlwind. Airborne opponents take −1 on attack and damage rolls against the elemental.
Whirlwind uses the air elemental rules from the original Monster Manual. Damage equals the slam dice without Strength. The Reflex DC is 10 + half the class Hit Dice + Constitution modifier.
Becomes Medium at 4th level and Large with 10-ft. reach at 13th. Gets damage reduction 5/+1 at 9th. At 14th level the class has 8d8 Hit Dice, ECL 14, and CR 5.

species.name: Imp
traits: A seven-level Tiny outsider monster class. Starts with +2 Dexterity, 20-ft. land speed, immunity to poison, and darkvision 60 ft. that works in magical darkness. Speaks Celestial, Draconic, and Infernal.

Starts with a venomous sting. At 2nd level gains bonus Weapon Finesse (sting) and at-will detect good and detect magic. The class spell-like abilities other than commune use twice the class Hit Dice as caster level.
At 3rd level gains flight, fire resistance 5, and one alternate form up to Medium, usable at will as polymorph self at caster level 12. Adds a second form at 6th.

At 4th level gains self-only invisibility at will and damage reduction 5/silver or holy. Higher tiers add regeneration, daily suggestion, weekly commune, and fast healing. At 7th level the class has 3d8 Hit Dice, ECL 7, and CR 2.
Sting applies Dexterity damage. Its Fortitude DC is 10 + half the class Hit Dice + Constitution modifier + 2. The table raises the dice as the class progresses.

species.name: Rakshasa
traits: A 14-level outsider monster class. Starts Medium with +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma, 40-ft. land speed, darkvision 60 ft., two claws, and Common, Infernal, and Undercommon.

Alternate Form starts at 1/day for one hour, rises to 3/day for up to two hours at 4th level, and becomes at will at 8th. It uses the original alter self spell at caster level 18, limited to humanoid forms.

Gains a bite and spells at 2nd level. Casts as a sorcerer of level equal to the class Hit Dice and may learn 1st-level cleric spells as arcane spells. Detect thoughts starts at 3rd level and uses class level + 4 as caster level and DC 12 + Charisma modifier.
At 4th level gains immunity to 1st-level spell effects. Later levels raise the maximum spell level affected. May suppress immunity to accept spells. Later tiers also grant damage reduction.
Any hit from a blessed crossbow bolt instantly kills the rakshasa. At 14th level the class has 7d8 Hit Dice, ECL 14, and CR 8.

species.publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
species.name: Smallfolk
traits: Can move through the space of Medium or larger creatures and try to hide behind one. Once per day, reroll a failed save, use the new result, and gain 1 Luck.
Gnomish adaptation gives darkvision and minor illusion. Halfling adaptation gives advantage on saves against charm and fright.

rules.name: Lycanthrope encounter rules
adjustments: Printed source. Lycanthrope, pp. 137 and 148.

Alternate Form (Su). Where available, take or leave an animal or hybrid form as a standard action. Equipment does not change. Entering either form heals as a day of rest. A slain lycanthrope returns to humanoid form where it has one, but severed parts keep their animal shape. An afflicted creature normally gains one alternate form and can struggle to control it.

Curse of Lycanthropy (Su). A qualifying bite to a humanoid within one size category requires Fortitude DC 18 or transmits the curse. Bludgeoning or nonpenetrating attacks cannot transmit it. Afflicted lycanthropes can spread it in Ravenloft. The general text specifies animal form, but a listed hybrid curse also uses this procedure at the table. Use any strain-specific exception below.

Natural lycanthropes generally have DR 10/silver in animal or hybrid form, while afflicted ones have DR 5/silver. Some strains name a different material. Low-light vision and scent work in any form unless the profile specifies otherwise. Lycanthropic empathy allows simple communication, gives a +4 racial bonus on attitude checks with the corresponding normal or dire animal, and permits simple commands to friendly animals.
A spellcaster cannot use verbal, somatic, or material components in animal form and cannot use verbal components in hybrid form. Apply the printed encounter stats for each form.

rules.name: Shared spectral hag rules
adjustments: Printed source. Hag, Spectral, pp. 108–111.

Chilling Touch (Su). A target hit by the spectral hag’s incorporeal touch makes a DC 15 Fortitude save. Failure gives it 2 negative levels. The touch still deals its listed hit point damage on a successful save.

Create Spectre (Su). A victim whose levels reach 0 through Chilling Touch and who dies rises as a spectre under the hag’s control. Spectres she creates can travel with her, obey her commands, and be called to aid her in combat.
Daylight suppresses the hag’s special powers without dealing damage. Her touch reaches creatures on either the Ethereal Plane or the Material Plane and keeps her original Strength bonus.
When former covey members die during the same evil ceremony, they may retain their covey. A former covey member the spectral hag kills rises as a spectral hag under her control.

rules.name: Dread elemental rules
rules.appliesTo: Blood, grave, mist, and pyre elementals
adjustments: Printed source. Elemental, Dread, p. 63, and Mists subtype, pp. 7–8.

In Ravenloft, calling a standard elemental has a 20% chance of producing a dread elemental. Summoning magic always produces the dread form. Accidental dread elementals are uncontrolled, and the Dark Powers supply the matching materials. Intentional conjuring requires the matching material and uses the usual chance for the elemental to break control.

Dread elementals understand speech but do not communicate. Their Mists subtype makes them native throughout Ravenloft and allows them to be summoned in any domain. A dismissed dread elemental returns to Ravenloft itself, so the realm's restrictions on calling do not break the calling pact.

rules.name: Fury shared rules
adjustments: Printed source. Furies, pp. 79–80. The sisters appear together and speak all humanoid languages. They try three times to divert a target from atonement before trying to kill them in public.
Defenses. Damage reduction 15/good. Immune to paralysis, polymorph, and mind-affecting effects.

Scourge. The +3 scourge works like a whip that deals 1d4 lethal damage before modifiers. A Fury may substitute it for her claw attacks. Use the attack and ability damage listed for that sister. Rake (Ex) is +9 melee for 1d4 + 1 damage.
Alter Self (Sp). At will as a standard action, a Fury can take the form of an elderly human woman indefinitely. Caster level 10.
Breath Weapon (Su, 3/day). Fill one adjacent square with foul air. Apply stinking cloud as cast by an 8th-level sorcerer, with a DC 16 Fortitude save.
Find Penitent (Su). Furies can locate a target who seeks redemption at the invitation or embrace stage of corruption. The target cannot hide from them, even with magic.

Gaseous Death (Su). At 0 HP, a Fury and her scourge dissolve into smoke. Surviving sisters continue to fight, though the last survivor tries to flee. If a sister survives, the slain Furies return at full HP after 24 hours. To kill them permanently, all three must die within the same 24 hours and an Innocent must deal the killing blows. Their scourges remain after permanent death.

Weaknesses. A good cleric or a paladin can turn each Fury separately by invoking her true name. A turning attempt cannot destroy, rebuke, or command her. A Fury cannot deliberately harm a good creature except with her breath weapon.

rules.name: Shared dread cloaker rules
adjustments: Printed source. Cloaker, Dread, p. 51.
Damage reduction (Su). A cloaker draped around its host shares its damage reduction against physical attacks other than area attacks.

Engulf (Ex). As a standard action, the cloaker envelops a creature at least one size category smaller. Its host is engulfed automatically. Any other target requires a successful grapple check without provoking an attack of opportunity. The target is pinned. A cloaker without a host gains +4 to bite the engulfed creature.

Split damage from attacks that hit an engulfing cloaker equally between it and its victim. Area spells deal full damage to both. A shadow or undead cloaker can still strike other targets with its tail while engulfing a creature.

rules.name: Heraldic servant rules
adjustments: Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.

A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.

Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.

An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.

The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

rules.name: Reading Black Flag stat blocks
rules.publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
adjustments: Rules source. Black Flag Reference Document, Monsters.

The printed modifiers and fixed HP are ready to use. For a Dexterity (Stealth) check to avoid the creature, use its Perception value as the DC. For a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect it, use its Stealth value as the DC.

Condition resistance gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the named condition. Condition vulnerability gives disadvantage. Apply damage resistance and vulnerability to the amount of damage instead.

rules.name: Haze-native creatures
rules.appliesTo: Nonhumanoid creatures encountered in Drakkenheim that originate in the Haze
adjustments: Printed source. Appendix A, pp. 196–197. These traits leave the creature’s CR as printed. They apply to Haze natives and exclude creatures recruited or summoned by the party.
Fully Contaminated. Immune to contamination and has advantage on saves against contaminated spells.
Haze Adaptation. Can benefit from a long rest in the Haze. It can see twice as far through the Haze and Deep Haze.
Haze Dependence. Gains one Exhaustion level for each 24 hours outside the Haze. It can remove those levels only in the Haze.
Delerium Healing. As an action, touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) HP. That shard cannot heal this way again for 24 hours.

rules.name: Arcane anomalies (Drakkenheim)
rules.appliesTo: Effects that trigger a random arcane anomaly
adjustments: Printed source. Appendix D, p. 225. Roll 1d20 for the anomaly.
1. Gravity fails in a 100-ft. radius for 1 hour. Unattended objects drift. Creatures float and can move as if climbing by pushing or pulling against surfaces or fixed objects.
2. The nearest creature is subject to Hideous Laughter, save DC 15. It babbles instead of laughing.
3. Creatures within 60 ft. are Stunned for 1 round, with no save.
4. The nearest creature gains Blink for 1 minute and slips through time when it vanishes.
5. In a 20-ft. radius, creatures make a DC 15 Constitution save. Failure deals 8d6 radiant damage and Blinds for 1 round. Wood turns into glass.
6. For 1 minute, attacks that hit within 60 ft. show a vision of the target dying from the hit.
7. Creatures within 30 ft. are subject to Irresistible Dance, save DC 15.
8. Part of the surroundings becomes a delerium elemental appropriate to its element.
9. The GM chooses or randomly determines an extraplanar creature. It stays for 1 hour and is friendly to whoever triggered the anomaly.
10. Humanoid corpses within 120 ft. rise as hostile Haze Husks.
11. The shadows of 1d6 random creatures come alive and attack their owners. Destroying a shadow leaves its owner without one for 24 hours.
12. Creatures within 60 ft. become Invisible for 1 minute, ending for each creature when it attacks or casts a spell.
13. The nearest creature makes a DC 15 Constitution save against 8d8 necrotic damage, halved on success. The next three nearest creatures within 60 ft. each heal the damage it took.
14. Hypnotic Pattern appears, save DC 15. Those Incapacitated by it weep.
15. Black Tentacles appears in the area for 1 hour, escape DC 15.
16. Objects within 60 ft. animate for 1 hour as under Animate Objects. They speak and remain nonhostile.
17. The nearest creature becomes an awakened shrub for 1 hour or until it drops to 0 HP, with no save.
18. Up to six random creatures within 120 ft. are subject to Slow for 1 minute, save DC 15.
19. One random creature within 60 ft. gains Haste for 1 minute.
20. A bowl of flowers and an aquatic mammal appear 100 ft. overhead.

rules.name: Delerium contamination
rules.appliesTo: Creatures exposed to the Haze, delerium, or attacks that inflict contamination
adjustments: Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.

Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.

Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.

A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.

Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

rules.name: MCDM minion rules
rules.appliesTo: Creatures with the MCDM Minion trait
adjustments: Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.

Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.

Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.

A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

rules.name: MCDM demon soul rules
rules.appliesTo: MCDM demons with Soul Devourer and Lethe
adjustments: Soul count. Use the printed starting total or roll the listed dice. Souls spent on a feature are deducted from the total. A demon can accumulate souls without a maximum.

Soul Devourer. When the demon drops a creature other than a Construct or Undead to 0 HP, or deals damage to a dying creature, that creature makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, the demon consumes its soul, adds 1 to its soul count, and the creature dies. Only Wish can restore it to life.

Lethe. At 0 souls, the demon has advantage on attacks and disadvantage on saving throws, and its Intelligence is 3. On each turn it must use its movement to get as close as possible to the nearest creature it senses with Soulsight. If able, it must then use its action to attack that creature and attempt to kill it. It can pursue no other goal until its soul count rises.

Soulsight. Within the creature’s listed radius, it perceives creatures other than Constructs and Undead. This counts as seeing them for its features. Physical objects, total cover, and supernatural effects do not block this sense unless a rule says they do.

rules.name: MCDM companion rules
adjustments: Shared turn. The caregiver and companion act on the same turn. The companion moves and uses its reaction and bonus action independently. To do anything with its action besides Dash, Disengage or Dodge, it normally needs a command that costs the caregiver a bonus action. It must see or hear the caregiver. If the caregiver is Incapacitated, it can act without a command. The GM chooses who controls it when the caregiver is Incapacitated or absent.

Ferocity. At the start of their turn, unless Incapacitated, the companion gains 1d4 Ferocity plus one for each enemy it sees or hears within 5 ft. A swarm sharing one stat block counts as one enemy. Spend the listed cost before taking a Ferocity action. It uses the companion’s action, requires the listed caregiver level and is unavailable during a rampage.

Rampage. After rolling Ferocity, a companion with at least 10 Ferocity risks a rampage if it is not Incapacitated. A caregiver who is not Incapacitated and can be seen or heard can prevent it with a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check against DC 5 + Ferocity, without spending an action. If the companion rampages, it immediately moves toward the nearest creature it senses and makes its signature attack, with extra damage equal to half its Ferocity on a hit. If an ally and enemy tie for nearest, roll any die. On an odd roll the caregiver’s player chooses a tied ally. On an even roll they choose a tied enemy. If it cannot reach a target, it Dashes toward it. If it senses none, it moves as far as it can in a random safe direction. Ferocity falls to 0 after this action or at the end of the turn.
Recovery. At 0 HP, a companion makes death saves. After combat, Ferocity resets to 0. A companion that is not dying first regains HP equal to its remaining Ferocity.

rules.name: Undead Nature and Strahd Zombie
adjustments: Use the named Strahd Zombie combat profile. Limb loss and continued movement are version-specific rules, separate from an ordinary zombie’s persistence check.

rules.name: Mist Zombie
rules.publication: DDAL04-01 - The Suits of the Mists
adjustments: Use the printed Mist Zombie encounter profile, named as a lesser form of Strahd Zombie. Its challenge rating and statistics are adventure-specific.

rules.name: Half-Dragon Ettin
adjustments: This adventure supplies an individual half-dragon combat record. Use its own challenge and attacks rather than the unmodified Ettin.

rules.name: Poltergeist
rules.publication: DDEX1-11 - Dark Pyramid of Sorcerer's Isle
adjustments: Use this adventure’s Poltergeist reference. It is a Specter variant, not an alternate name for the normal Specter.

rules.name: Half-Dragon Troll
rules.publication: DDEX1-12 - Raiders of the Twilight Marsh
adjustments: Use the adventure’s Half-Dragon Troll profile. Keep its creature-specific regeneration and breath effects separate from the ordinary Troll.

rules.name: Spore Servant Forms
rules.appliesTo: Drow, duergar, hook horror, and chuul
adjustments: Species-specific servants are distinct encounter forms. The named servant profiles take precedence over the ordinary creature’s statistics.

rules.name: Vampiric Ixitxachitl
rules.publication: Out of the Abyss - D&D Encounters
adjustments: Use this version’s challenge and combat profile. Its vampiric bite can reduce maximum hit points and restore the attacker.

rules.name: Feral Tiefling
adjustments: The alternate ability increases may accompany one other mechanical tiefling option. Choose at most one of Devil’s Tongue, Hellfire, and wings.

rules.name: Half-Elf Descent Options
adjustments: Choose the ancestry-appropriate replacement for Skill Versatility, and keep the other Half-Elf traits.

rules.name: Lycanthrope
adjustments: This edition supplies its own template. Prefer the Ravenloft version’s eligibility and powers when preparing a creature from this book.

rules.name: Skeleton
adjustments: This edition supplies its own template. Prefer the Ravenloft version’s eligibility and powers when preparing a creature from this book.

rules.name: Ancient Dead (Mummy)
adjustments: This edition supplies its own template. Prefer the Ravenloft version’s eligibility and powers when preparing a creature from this book.

rules.name: Ghost
adjustments: This edition supplies its own template. Prefer the Ravenloft version’s eligibility and powers when preparing a creature from this book.

rules.name: Lycanthrope
adjustments: This edition supplies its own template. Prefer the Ravenloft version’s eligibility and powers when preparing a creature from this book.

rules.name: Skeleton
adjustments: This edition supplies its own template. Prefer the Ravenloft version’s eligibility and powers when preparing a creature from this book.

rules.name: Celestial Creature
adjustments: Animals and vermin become magical beasts. Intelligence is at least 3. Add smite evil, darkvision, and the Hit Dice-dependent resistances and damage reduction. Challenge increases with Hit Dice.

rules.name: Fiendish Creature
adjustments: Animals and vermin become magical beasts. Intelligence is at least 3. Add smite good, darkvision, and the Hit Dice-dependent fire and cold defenses.

rules.name: Ghost
rules.appliesTo: Eligible creatures with Charisma at least 6
adjustments: Change the creature to incorporeal undead. Use the base creature’s attack progression and saves, add manifestation, and select one to three ghost powers. Rejuvenation changes how the party can defeat it permanently.

rules.name: Half-Celestial
adjustments: Becomes a native outsider where applicable. Add wings, smite evil, and the Hit Dice-dependent spell-like abilities. Ability adjustments include Strength +4, Dexterity +2, and Constitution +4.

rules.name: Half-Dragon
adjustments: Type becomes dragon. Strength +8, Constitution +2, Intelligence +2, Charisma +2. Add the ancestry-specific breath and damage immunity. A Large or larger base gains wings.

rules.name: Half-Fiend
adjustments: Type becomes outsider. Strength +4, Dexterity +4, Constitution +2, Intelligence +4, Charisma +2. Add flight, natural attacks, smite good, and the Hit Dice-based spell-like abilities.

rules.name: Lich
rules.appliesTo: A humanoid that can meet the magical prerequisites
adjustments: Type becomes undead. Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma each rise by 2. Add the fear aura, paralyzing touch, phylactery return, and lich damage defenses. Challenge increases by 2.

rules.name: Lycanthrope
rules.appliesTo: Humanoid or giant of suitable size for the chosen animal
adjustments: Choose an animal form relative to the base creature’s size. Add animal Hit Dice and apply the separate physical ability adjustments for animal and hybrid forms. Keep natural-born and afflicted versions distinct.

rules.name: Skeleton
rules.appliesTo: Eligible corporeal base with a skeletal structure
adjustments: Type becomes undead. Remove special attacks, skills, and most feats. Dexterity rises by 2. No Constitution or Intelligence. Apply cold immunity and DR 5/bludgeoning. Challenge uses the skeleton’s Hit Dice.

rules.name: Vampire
adjustments: Type becomes undead. Add domination, energy drain, spawn creation, gaseous form, fast healing, damage defenses, and vampire weaknesses. Distinguish a full vampire from a vampire spawn.

rules.name: Zombie
adjustments: Type becomes undead. Discard class Hit Dice and recalculate racial Hit Dice for the zombie. Strength rises by 2 and Dexterity falls by 2; no Constitution or Intelligence. Apply its action limit and DR 5/slashing.
